jobs.title: Program Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**Abode Services**, one of the largest and effective nonprofits working to end homelessness in the Bay Area, is seeking a Program Coordinator I for our program in San Jose, CA. ***\* Please be advise the shift for this position is: Tuesday- Friday 12:00 PM-8:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM***

**About Abode:**

At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.

**Our Values:**

We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!

**The Diverse Culture:**

We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.

**About The Role**:

The Program Coordinator will supervise the provision of services to program participants in the County, through direct staff supervision of staff.

**How You Make An Impact**: :

* Supervise the provision of housing for programs in the County through direct supervision of staff.
* Improve housing program skills through supervision, coaching, and training of staff. Address performance issues, as necessary.
* Provide support to the team when dealing with complex participant and/or landlord issues, which may include leading case conferencing meetings, connecting staff with other community resources for support, and providing direct services to clients/landlords.
* Provide housing location services for clients and ensure collaboration with appropriate Abode staff to ensure subsidy payments.
* Complete initial and annual HQS inspections accurately and on time.
* Maintain relationships with property owners and manage housing stock. This will mean developing new landlord contacts, as well as maintaining current units.
* Communicate closely and frequently with all members of the housing and services team to improve systems, solve problems, share resources, and coordinate work.
* Ensuring timely completion of HMIS annual updates, and quarterly/yearly income assessments as needed.
* Maintain housing files and support Compliance Specialists to ensure program compliance.
* Attends staff meetings and other agency functions as needed. Oversee audits and monthly program reports as needed.
* Maintain unit/participant information in WMAT. Run rent reports and ensure property owner payments.
* Ensure accuracy of participant rent calculations and upload to WMAT/participant files.
* Work with the manager/finance team to ensure appropriate budget maintenance. Review monthly MER reports.
* Maintain knowledge of HUD regulations/prepare files for monthly audits with the County.
* Other duties as assigned.

**How You Meet Qualifications**:

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field and equivalent experience.
* 2 years of field experience working with people with co-occurring disorders and/or who are homeless.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of valid California Driver's License and current auto insurance, along with a clean DMV record, is required.
* Driving and transportation of participants when required.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.

COMPETENCIES:

* Professional experience in the human services, social work, psychology, or related field and demonstrated experience in rental housing programs for low income, special needs individuals and families.
* Ability to work within a housing first philosophy and Harm Reduction model and lead others to work with these models.
* Basic knowledge and understanding of applicable federal, state, and local laws.
* Excellent verbal & written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business-related applications.
* Ability to build supportive and respectful working relationships with transition age youth that instills hope and promotes self-determination using a strengths-based approach.
* Possess an understanding of and practice cultural sensitivity through open dialogue and self-exploration with diverse groups, while providing direct services.
* Ability to effectively intervene in crisis situations and make sound decisions in difficult situations with participants.
* Outstanding communication skills and high degree of emotional intelligence, cultural humility, with a proven track record to build and maintain effective relationships with a wide variety of internal and external contacts.

**Our Benefits and Perks:**

* **Compensation: $33.65-$37.02 (DOE)**
* **Schedule:** Full-time, Non-Exempt
* **Work Arrangement:** Onsite**Shift :** Tuesday- Friday 12:00 PM-8:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM-5:00 PM
* **PTO**:19 days per year, increasing with tenure
* **Holidays**: 12 paid holidays per year

  + Retirement Plan: 403(b) Plan w/ Employer Match & Contribution Programs

The Administrator is a key position in driving the organization’s success. They are responsible for both clinical and financial success of their Program which contributes the overall success of both Telecare and those we serve. The individual in this role is responsible for overseeing and leading the team of people providing patient care as well as managing the business operations of the Program. They are responsible for managing all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the Program, which involves ensuring successful management and leadership over the 4 Pillars of performance: Clinical Quality, Workforce Engagement, Customer Satisfaction, and Financial Security. Additionally, the Administrator collaborates with all corporate functions and outside consultants and representatives of the program to State/County agencies, community partners, and consumer groups. Employees in this role are required to participate in a structured on-call rotation, remaining accessible and prepared to respond to work-related needs within a designated timeframe. Rotations are scheduled in advance. While on-call, employees must actively monitor communications (e.g., phone, email) and respond in accordance with operational protocols.

jobs.title: Family Life Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SALARY RANGE**

$30 - $32 per hour.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Family Life Coordinator keeps the department organized, connected, and moving forward. Working closely with Family Life leadership and program managers, this position coordinates shared priorities, upcoming programs, and operational needs across all Family Life functions. These include Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, Dance, Musical Theater, Playdate, Maccabi initiatives, and family events.

The Coordinator gathers information from managers, brings the team together, tracks responsibilities and deadlines, and follows up to ensure plans move into action. The role anticipates needs, identifies gaps, and brings timely updates and requests for decisions to leadership. Program managers retain responsibility for program strategy, budgets, and staff supervision; the Coordinator supports execution and accountability through clear organization and consistent follow-through.

This is a highly collaborative position requiring initiative, sound judgment, and confidence in working with colleagues at different levels. It combines department coordination, hands-on program support, customer service, and routine administration. The position works on-site five days per week and moves regularly between the office and active program spaces.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Department Coordination and Follow-Through**

* Maintain a shared department calendar and action tracker covering upcoming programs, launches, events, key deadlines, responsible staff, and operational needs.
* Check in regularly with program managers to understand what is coming up, what support is needed, and where plans require coordination across areas.
* Organize and help facilitate Family Life operations meetings; gather agenda items, document decisions and action items, and follow up on commitments.
* Prompt managers and leadership for needed information, approvals, and decisions; provide concise progress updates and flag delays or unresolved issues early.
* Coordinate shared staffing, space, equipment, and communication needs; help resolve scheduling conflicts and bring resource decisions to the appropriate manager.
* Help translate agreed priorities into practical next steps and coordinate with Facilities, Marketing, Account Services, and other internal partners to move work forward.

##### **Program Readiness and Operations**

* Coordinate operational preparation for Tikvah, Athletics, Youth Recreation, Camp, and other Family Life programs, including schedules, space reservations, staffing logistics, supplies, and equipment.
* Use practical readiness checklists to confirm that rosters, participant information, materials, family communications, and staff instructions are available before programs begin.
* Ensure coaches, instructors, seasonal staff, and other program team members receive timely schedules, updates, and the resources needed to deliver programs.
* Coordinate training logistics and help managers arrange coverage for open shifts, breaks, or absences; communicate coverage gaps promptly.

##### **Hands-On Program Support**

* Provide an active on-site presence during programs and events, supporting check-in and check-out, attendance, participant transitions, setup, breakdown, and family questions.
* Step into program activities or temporary coverage as needed, including recreation, athletics, camp, and customer service duties appropriate to training and experience.
* Support Tikvah activities and participants under the direction of program leadership, following individual support guidance and established inclusion and safety practices.
* Observe program flow, respond to routine operational needs, and alert managers to concerns affecting safety, staffing, or participant experience.

##### **Family Experience and Administrative Support**

* Provide welcoming, responsive service to families and maintain a working knowledge of Family Life programs, schedules, and participation options.
* Coordinate approved program reminders and updates, and route participant concerns or questions requiring a decision to the appropriate manager.
* Partner with the Family Life Administrator and Program Managers on registrations, transfers, refunds, waitlists, rosters, and participant records; assist with routine tasks as needed using established procedures.
* Use basic Salesforce and other department tools to update records, access routine reports, and track program readiness and operational needs.
* Maintain organized attendance records, forms, waivers, and other required documentation, protecting confidential participant and family information.
* Follow established departmental procedures and complete other related duties as assigned.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* BA or BS degree required, or equivalent combination of experience and education.
* At least 2 years of experience in youth programing.
* Salesforce experience a plus.
* Outstanding customer service skills and experience working in a customer-centric organization.
* Experience and ability in designing, creating managing and implementing schedules, reports, and operational plans.
* Outstanding computer skills, including advanced skills in MS Office and the ability to learn new business software programs.
* Experience working with children age 3-13 Working knowledge of child development is a plus.
* Previous experience working in an athletics/ recreation/camp background, specifically within program facilitation and support.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Must be well-organized with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work as part of a team and effectively engage and coordinate with various stakeholders (both staff and clients).
* Ability to handle multiple projects, setting appropriate priorities, and effective time management while ensuring that all deadlines are honored.

jobs.title: Sr. Customer Care Specialist, UNC
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Pioneer Metal Finishing is the leading surface engineering company in North America. For over 75 years, we’ve delivered consistent, quality metal finishing solutions for mission-critical applications. Our advanced surface modification technologies and scalable execution improve the performance of mission-critical products and enhance brand value for companies in the healthcare, aerospace, automotive, and industrial markets. We encourage you to learn more about opportunities with Pioneer Metal Finishing and join our team today!

Overview:

Job Summary

The Sr. Customer Care Specialist is responsible for delivering consistent day-to-day customer care while providing account-level coordination for assigned customers. This role serves as a primary operational point of contact from order receipt through shipment, ensuring accurate execution, proactive communication, and timely issue resolution. In addition to core customer care responsibilities, the position supports account management, customer retention, new program implementation, and organic growth within existing customer relationships. The position is intended for an experienced customer care professional who can independently lead complex customer matters, strengthen assigned customer relationships, and contribute to customer retention and account growth.

Essential Job Duties / Responsibilities

* Manage customer purchase orders from receipt through shipment, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timely entry, and required documentation.
* Validate pricing, part numbers, revisions, lead times, specifications, and special requirements before order release.
* Maintain orders, customer records, communications, and case activity in ERP systems with a high degree of accuracy and timeliness.
* Own order changes, expedites, delivery updates, and administrative follow-through, coordinating with internal teams to align commitments.
* Monitor order status, backlog, open cases, and past-due risk; take proactive action to prevent service failures and keep customers informed.
* Respond professionally to inquiries involving delivery timing, pricing discrepancies, quality concerns, documentation, billing, credits, and other service needs.
* Coordinate issue resolution across Operations, Scheduling, Quality, Engineering, Shipping and Receiving, Finance, Estimating, and other partners; maintain ownership through closure.
* Escalate significant risks and customer concerns with clear facts, business impact, recommended actions, and appropriate urgency.
* Serve as the relationship owner for assigned customers, building trust through responsiveness, consistency, and reliable follow-through.
* Develop a working understanding of assigned customers, programs, forecast signals, service expectations, and priorities.
* Prepare for and participate in customer reviews and internal account health discussions; communicate trends, risks, commitments, and recovery actions.
* Coordinate onboarding and implementation activities for new programs within existing customer relationships, including requirements, documentation, timing, and internal ownership.
* Identify opportunities for new parts, programs, services, or volume within existing accounts and engage the appropriate Sales resource.
* Partner with Sales on quotations, renewals, pricing discussions, and growth opportunities while operating within established authority and approval processes.
* Provide informal guidance, cross-training, and backup support to team members and model disciplined customer care practices.
* Identify recurring service, communication, and order-flow breakdowns and help implement sustainable process improvements.
* Perform other duties as assigned based on business needs.

Work Environment

* Work is performed primarily in an office setting within an active manufacturing facility.
* Regular onsite interaction with production, quality, shipping, and other operational areas is required.
* May occasionally be exposed to noise, odors, temperature variation, moving equipment, chemicals, or other conditions associated with a metal-finishing environment.
* Wear personal protective equipment deemed necessary for the job and comply with all facility safety requirements.

Experience and Education

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate's or Bachelor's Degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
* Five or more years of progressive experience in customer service, customer care, order management, account coordination, or a related role; manufacturing or industrial experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing customer orders, complex issues, competing priorities, and cross-functional follow-through with limited direction.
* Experience using ERP and/or CRM systems for order management, customer documentation, issue tracking, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, technical documentation, prints, specifications, or quality requirements preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with consistent attention to detail.
* Ability to recognize customer needs and organic growth opportunities and engage Sales at the appropriate time.
* Ability to effectively utilize language through speaking, reading, and writing.
* Must possess effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills and maintain professionalism under pressure.
* Ability and willingness to work onsite in a fast-paced, production-driven environment.

* **Next-Day Pay:** Don’t wait for payday; access your daily pay the next day!

jobs.title: Research Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About AfterQuery**
====================

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

**Why Apply**
=============

**Massive Opportunity:** Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

**Founding Impact:** You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

**Equity & Growth:** Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

**Strong Team:** Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.

**Overview**
------------

AfterQuery is hiring a Research Program Manager to run the operations behind its research programs: public benchmark releases, collaborations with academic and industry partners, and the research roadmap. You own the coordination, external relationships, and progress tracking that keep the program moving, and you are welcome to contribute to the research itself, from benchmark design to co-authoring publications.

This is a technical, hands-on role, not a pure coordination one. You will read results tables, run evals, sanity-check numbers before they go public, and turn loosely specified research needs into engineering and operational roadmaps. You will also be the program's voice to external partners, so clear writing and confident communication across researchers, executives, and academics are as important as technical fluency. You work daily with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and go-to-market partners.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the point of contact for collaborations with academic and industry partners, including fellowships, grants, and joint research projects, and run each from scoping through delivery.
* Coordinate benchmark releases end to end, from launch checklist through publication, and keep releases on cadence.
* Maintain AfterQuery's leaderboards and benchmark sites, and verify every result before it goes to a community leaderboard or publication.
* Track progress across all active research projects. Anticipate resourcing gaps and technical bottlenecks, unblock projects that fall behind, and escalate with a clear recommendation when a timeline or scope needs to change.
* Coordinate the expert pool for upcoming benchmarks: forecast expert needs, manage capacity, and keep contributor logistics running.
* Write the program's external and internal communications: launch briefs, partner updates, planning documents, and status memos that turn technical detail into clear, actionable summaries.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 1-3+ years in research operations, technical program management, or a similar role in a fast-moving research or engineering organization.
* Technical background in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field, with working Python and SQL.
* Evaluation literacy: you have taken part in evaluating a product, an agent, or a foundation model, can read a results table, and can tell when a number should not be trusted.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can distill a technical result into a summary a partner, executive, or academic collaborator can act on, and you write documents people actually read.
* A track record of running cross-functional programs end to end, including managing external partners, contractors, or collaborators.
* Comfort with ambiguity and building processes from scratch, and the judgment to keep processes light so researchers stay effective.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Graduate degree or research experience in a technical field.
* Contributed to a benchmark, dataset, or evaluation project in any role.
* Familiarity with public leaderboards or open research communities.
* Exposure to programs with external partners, such as fellowships, grants, or academic collaborations.
* Exposure to expert or annotator pools, or other human-data work.
* Comfort with lightweight dashboards or building small tools with AI assistants.

**Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):**
----------------------------------------------

* Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend
* Monthly Wellness Stipend

We comply with applicable pay transparency requirements and provide compensation ranges based on the position, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
Gator Bio is a bioanalytical technology company located in Palo Alto, CA. We are creating innovative technologies to solve difficult problems facing today’s biopharma industry. We develop, manufacture, and sell instruments, biosensors, reagents, and consumables for antibody, gene, and cell therapy development. Gator Bio’s current product portfolio includes biolayer interferometry (BLI) systems using optic fiber biosensors.

We are looking for a **QA Specialist** to join our Quality Assurance team. The QA Specialist will play an important role in maintaining the company’s established Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with applicable quality requirements, and supporting the continuous improvement of quality system processes.

### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Quality Management System**

* Maintain the established Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with applicable standards and company procedures.
* Promote awareness and compliance with quality requirements across the organization.

**Document and Change Control**

* Manage controlled documents, quality records, forms, and other quality-related documentation.
* Manage document and change control activities, including document revisions, approvals, implementation, and periodic reviews.

**Training**

* Manage the quality training program, including the training matrix, training assignments, and completion tracking.
* Follow up on overdue training and maintain training records.
* Coordinate training related to quality system procedures and requirements.

**Equipment Calibration and Maintenance**

* Manage the equipment calibration and maintenance program.
* Monitor calibration and maintenance schedules and due dates.
* Maintain calibration and maintenance records and follow up to ensure activities are completed on time.
* Support the evaluation and documentation of out-of-calibration or out-of-service equipment.

**Product Release**

* Perform product and/or batch release by reviewing required quality records and documentation.
* Work with Manufacturing and QC to ensure quality requirements are completed prior to release.
* Support the investigation and resolution of quality issues that may affect product quality or release.

**Quality Activities Support**

* Support nonconformance (NCR), CAPA, complaint handling, and audit activities as needed.
* Perform other QA and quality-related activities as assigned.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation for assigned quality activities.

**Cross-Functional Support**

* Work closely with Manufacturing, R&D, QC, Operations, and other functions to support quality activities and resolve quality issues.
* Provide timely QA support for projects and operational activities.

### **QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific or technical field.
* 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance in a life science, biotechnology, diagnostics, medical device, or other regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of Quality Management Systems and applicable quality standards.
* Experience with quality documentation and records.
* Attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on assigned activities.
* Written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in an ISO 13485, FDA-regulated, or other regulated life science environment.
* Experience performing product or batch release.
* Experience with equipment calibration and maintenance programs.
* Experience with electronic QMS or other quality management systems.
* Familiarity with GxP requirements.

Experience working in an IVD, biotechnology, medical device, or analytical instrument environment.

### **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* This role will require lengthy periods of standing and sitting.
* The employee will be required to use hands for computer work.
* Health screening: Not required

Travel: N/A

jobs.title: Manager, Care Team
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Manager, Care Team to join our team at Independent Living Systems (ILS). ILS, along with its affiliated health plans known as Florida Community Care and Florida Complete Care, is committed to promoting a higher quality of life and maximizing independence for all vulnerable populations.

**About the Role:**

The Manager, Care Team plays a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality health care services to members. This position is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the care team, ensuring that all staff members are effectively trained and supported in their roles. The Manager will work closely with healthcare professionals to develop and implement care plans that meet the diverse needs of members. Additionally, this role involves monitoring member outcomes and satisfaction to continuously improve service delivery. Ultimately, the Manager of the Care Team is dedicated to fostering a compassionate and efficient environment that prioritizes member well-being and safety.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Health Administration, or a related field required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in a healthcare setting, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role required.
* Current and valid professional BSW, MSW or LVN, RN, licensure in the State of CA.
* Requires knowledge of and experience working with community agencies and programs.
* Requires experience with Medi-Cal eligibility guidelines, application, and renewal/redetermination process.
* Requires strong problem-solving and customer service skills.
* Must be a CA Resident, and must reside in CA while employed.
* Current and valid California (CA) Driver’s License.
* Must use personal vehicle and current vehicle registration required.
* Proof of auto insurance required, must maintain CA minimum insurance coverage.
* BCLS CPR Certification required.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Social Work, Nursing, Health Administration, or a related field.
* Experience with electronic health record (EHR) systems.

**Responsibilities:**

* Conducts interviews and hiring of direct reports. Completes a ninety-day introductory and annual performance evaluation of each direct report. Facilitates professional growth and improved proficiency of staff who are direct and indirect reports through mentoring and training. Conducts ongoing performance management of each direct report; establishes performance goals; and measures performance against goals.
* Ensure the development and implementation of care plans in collaboration with the care team, healthcare professionals, caregivers, and members.
* Coordinate daily operations of the care team, including scheduling, resource allocation, and workflow management.
* Monitor patient care quality metrics and implement improvement plans to address any gaps or challenges.
* Collaborate with healthcare providers, administrative staff, and external partners to ensure seamless care coordination.
* Manage compliance with healthcare regulations, organizational policies, and safety standards.
* Conduct one on ones, audits and regular team meetings to support professional growth and accountability.
* Develop and implement training programs to enhance team skills and knowledge.
* Address patient and staff concerns promptly and effectively to maintain a positive care environment.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Technician
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Promex Industries specializes in custom assembly processes focusing on complex microelectronics and small component assemblies that require precise fabrication. With a longstanding presence in Silicon Valley, Promex offers a fully integrated, US-based facility dedicated to supporting biotech instrument and medical device companies from prototype to full-scale production.

**Position Summary:**

The Quality Assurance Technician supports and maintains the company's Quality Management System (QMS). The Technician administers the training and calibration programs, maintains controlled quality records, supports internal and external audits, and helps drive nonconformance, corrective action and quality data activities to closure. Working alongside the QC Inspector, the Technician applies inspection expertise (IPC workmanship standards, sampling plans and precision measurement) to support incoming and outgoing inspection, resolve acceptance questions and provide inspection backup when needed.

**Essential Duties:**

**QMS Operational Support**

· Administer the calibration program: maintain the equipment list and recall schedule, coordinate outside calibration vendors, review calibration certificates for acceptability, perform and record in-house verifications, and quarantine and report out-of-tolerance equipment.

· Maintain the training program, including the training matrix by position, the training schedule, and tracking of due, overdue and recurring training and re-qualifications.

· Schedule and coordinate training sessions with internal trainers, department supervisors and outside providers; notify employees and supervisors of upcoming and overdue training.

· Prepare for and support internal, customer and registrar audits by retrieving records, demonstrating processes and following up on findings.

· Document nonconforming material (NCMR), support MRB disposition, and gather objective evidence for corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) and supplier corrective actions (SCAR); track actions to closure.

· Collect, check and verify quality records to ensure the activities are completed as planned.

· Conduct ESD, 5S and in-process audit.

· Support material compliance management and compile compliance reports per guidance

**Inspection**

· Serve as technical resource to the QC Inspectors and operators on borderline acceptance questions.

· Conduct incoming, in-process and outgoing inspection of purchased materials and SMT assemblies to IPC-A-600/IPC-A-610, drawings and customer requirements.

· Perform specialized measurements using a Micro-Vu (or equivalent) vision measuring system, calipers, micrometers, gauges and microscopes, X-ray imaging, and XRF for plating thickness and RoHS/material verification.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

· High school diploma or GED.

· 5+ years of working experience and 3+ years of quality experience in an electronics manufacturing (SMT/PCBA) environment, including support of QMS operation.

· Working knowledge of IPC-A-610; familiarity with IPC J-STD-001 and IPC-A-600.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook, with accurate data entry.

· Working knowledge of QMS requirements (e.g., ISO 9001) for training, calibration, document control and records.

· Understanding of attribute sampling plans (ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 and c=0) and basic calibration concepts (traceability, tolerance, recall intervals).

· Hands-on experience with precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges) and inspection microscopes

· Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs and specifications.

**Key Competencies:**

· **Organization & Follow-Through:** Manages schedules, due dates and recalls so that training and calibration never lapse, and follows open items to closure.

· **Computer Literacy:** Familiar with Microsoft Office, QMS software and other applications for record maintenance; learns new systems quickly.

· **Technical Judgment:** Applies acceptance criteria consistently and escalates borderline conditions appropriately.

· **Documentation Discipline:** Keeps records complete, accurate, legible and on time.

· **Attention to Detail:** Catches gaps and errors in records as well as workmanship and dimensional defects.

· **Communication:** Follows up clearly with employees, supervisors, vendors and the QC Inspector on training, calibration, inspection and corrective action items.

· **Integrity & Independence:** Holds the line on quality requirements under schedule pressure.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Associate degree or technical certificate in electronics, manufacturing or quality technology.

· Current IPC-A-610 Certified IPC Specialist (CIS); J-STD-001 certification a plus.

· Experience in an ISO 13485 or AS9100 quality system, including participation in audits.

· Experience with a Micro-Vu or other vision/CMM measuring system, and with XRF, X-ray or AOI inspection equipment.

· Experience in MIL-STD-883 optical inspection.

**Work Environment:**

· Combination of quality office and manufacturing/inspection-lab environment, including ESD-controlled areas and cleanrooms; requires wearing ESD/cleanroom equipment.

· Regular computer work for record maintenance, plus periods of sitting or standing at microscopes and inspection stations with close visual work and fine hand manipulation.

· Occasionally lifts and moves materials up to 25 lbs.

· Works with XRF equipment that emits ionizing radiation; must follow the company radiation safety program.

· This position may require access to export-controlled (ITAR) technical data; if so, the candidate must qualify as a U.S. Person.

Join us at Promex Industries where your expertise will directly contribute to the production of high-quality medical devices that make a difference worldwide!

jobs.title: Packaging Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Allogene:**

Allogene Therapeutics, with headquarters in South San Francisco, is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering the development of allogeneic chimeric antigen receptor T cell (AlloCAR T) products for cancer and autoimmune disease. Led by a management team with significant experience in cell therapy, Allogene is developing a pipeline of “off-the-shelf” CAR T cell product candidates with the goal of delivering readily available cell therapy on-demand, more reliably, and at greater scale to more patients.

**About the role:**

Allogene Therapeutics is seeking a highly motivated Packaging Operations Manager to support the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of packaging systems, labeling components, and cold chain packaging supporting the manufacture and distribution of Allogene's clinical and commercial cell therapy products. This role helps ensure that packaging and labeling systems for the company’s first product launch comply with GMP, regulatory, and patient-specific requirements while maintaining product integrity throughout manufacturing, cryogenic storage, transportation, and delivery. This role supports the preparation and launch of Allogene’s first commercial cell therapy product.

The position will be located at Allogene headquarters in South San Francisco, CA. The ideal candidate is an individual who is interested in working in a fast-paced, dynamic, and highly collaborative biotech environment with a willingness and ability to successfully take on new challenges.

**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Packaging Engineering: Own the design, qualification, and lifecycle management of secondary/tertiary packaging systems for cryopreserved cell therapy products, ensuring product quality and protection across manufacturing, storage, shipping, and clinical-to-commercial transitions.
* Cold Chain Packaging Systems: Support the technical performance and qualification of cold chain shipping systems (dry shippers, temperature monitors, data loggers, insulated containers) by managing Validation protocols, thermal mapping, and lane/transportation validation studies, and analyzing shipping data to drive corrective actions.
* Packaging Design and Engineering: Support the technical lifecycle, specifications, and GMP-compliant documentation of printed packaging components (labels, cartons, IFUs, inserts) and lead Allogene's commercial packaging design and validation - including supplier qualification, cryogenic/transport performance testing, artwork and material selection, and packaging-related risk assessments impacting patient material.
* CMO and Supplier Management: manage chosen CMOs for secondary and tertiary packaging, including manufacturers, contract packagers, and contracted cold chain distribution.
* Artwork and Printing Management: Serve as the lead for artwork implementation, verifying manufacturability, packaging compatibility, and specification alignment while supporting change control and collaborating with Regulatory Affairs, Marketing and Quality on approved labeling updates. Manage print suppliers, coordinate printing and troubleshoot printing issues.
* First product launch: Ensure completion of activities to ensure on on-time launch for Allogene’s first commercial product. Coordinate all packaging related launch activities.

**Position Requirements & Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Packaging Science, or a related field with at least 3 years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, with a strong preference for cell or gene therapy, package design and development, and/or cold chain management.
* Knowledge of cGMP regulations and regulatory expectations; familiarity with FDA, EMA, and Annex 13 labeling requirements is a plus.
* Familiarity with cryogenic or cold-chain packaging and autologous or allogeneic cell therapy supply chains is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of artwork management and print processes for packaging components.
* Experience with product launches is preferred.
* Ability to communicate and collaborate with different stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Process Development, and others.
* Ability to effectively work in a fast-paced, biotech environment while dealing with ambiguity.
* Excellent organizational skills and an ability to prioritize effectively to deliver results within reasonably established timelines.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a desire to improve upon established processes.
* Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S.

We offer a chance to work with talented people in a collaborative environment and provide a top-notch compensation and benefits package, which includes an annual performance bonus, equity, health insurance, generous time off (including 2 annual holiday company-wide shutdowns) and much more. The expected salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000 per year. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, business needs, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

As an equal opportunity employer, Allogene is committed to a diverse workforce. OR

Columbus Cafe is launching an off-site beverage catering business, and we’re looking for an experienced hospitality professional to help build and grow it.

This is not primarily a bartending job. We’re looking for someone who can **sell events, build client relationships, organize operations, and manage events from the first inquiry through completion.**

We already have the Columbus Cafe brand, initial beverage concepts, operating resources, and the licensing foundation. We need someone who can take ownership of the catering business and help turn it into a profitable, repeatable operation.

* Help refine beverage packages, pricing, minimums, and upgrades.

* Coordinate staffing, beverage quantities, purchasing, transportation, setup, and event logistics.
* Track leads, bookings, event costs, and profitability.

We’re especially interested in candidates with experience in:

* Catering or event sales
* Hotel or restaurant events
* Beverage catering or mobile bars
* Weddings or corporate events
* Hospitality business development
* Event production

The strongest candidate will be a confident salesperson, highly organized, comfortable working independently, and able to manage multiple clients and events at the same time.

Existing relationships with Bay Area event planners, venues, hotels, corporate clients, or wedding professionals are especially valuable.

Experience with California alcohol compliance or off-site beverage service is helpful, but not required.

This is an **employee position paying $20–$25 per hour, plus substantial performance-based commission** tied to the business you help generate and the profitability of completed events.

Specific commission terms will be discussed during the interview process and documented in writing before employment begins.

**Schedule:**

Approximately **25–35 hours per week during the launch period**, depending on sales activity and event volume.

The schedule is flexible, but some evening and weekend availability is required for events.

Why This Role Is Different

This is an opportunity to help build a new business rather than simply step into an existing management position.

jobs.title: Training and Communications Program Manager
jobs.description:
Stanford University is one of Silicon Valley's largest employers - and one of the most unique. Our mission is to educate future leaders and promote interdisciplinary, world-class research and teaching. This passion makes Stanford an intensely creative, rewarding, and challenging place to work. At Stanford University, not only are you part of an exceptional team that values innovation and education, but you also become part of a culture that brings out the best in you. Stanford is committed to fostering a workplace culture that promotes diversity, collaboration, and professional growth. Our culture offers career development programs, competitive pay that reflects market trends and benefits that increase financial stability and promote healthy, fulfilling lives.

Research—the creation of new knowledge—is key to Stanford’s educational mission. Stanford research has led to breakthrough remedies, devices, tools, and concepts, and hundreds of initiatives solely for the betterment of humanity. Among the inventions and discoveries that have resulted from Stanford research are MRI technology, DNA cloning, the Pill, heart transplantation, and digital music.

Stanford is investing unprecedented resources in the Office of Research Administration (ORA) due to a growth in the research enterprise that continues to surpass 12% yearly. The Contract & Grant Officer position provides high-quality, personalized services and expertise to support our faculty and campus community. ORA submits over 5,000 new proposals, reviews and negotiates over 7,000 agreements, and manages more than 7,500 active sponsored projects annually with a total research budget approaching $2 billion.

The Property Management Office (PMO) is an integral part of the Office of Research Administration (ORA). Through a network of approximately 300 Department Property Administrators (DPAs) throughout the University, PMO ensures equipment is effectively managed from the time of acquisition through disposal. PMO is responsible for the oversight, accounting, compliance, training, and implementation of policies and procedures to manage a $1.3 billion dollar infrastructure of *moveable equipment* used in support of the education and research mission of Stanford.

This position is eligible for an onsite or hybrid work arrangement.

The expected pay range for this position is $90,293 to $104,000 per annum. Stanford University provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of the salary or hourly wage the university reasonably expects to pay for a position upon hire. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, geographic location and external market pay for comparable jobs.

At Stanford University, base pay represents only one aspect of the comprehensive rewards package. The Cardinal at Work website (https://cardinalatwork.stanford.edu/benefits-rewards) provides detailed information on Stanford’s extensive range of benefits and rewards offered to employees. Specifics about the rewards package for this position may be discussed during the hiring process.

**JOB PURPOSE:**

The Training and Communications Program Manager in the Property Management Office (PMO) provides overall leadership, coordination, and management of the program. They may report to the Assistant Director or Senior Director. Under general supervision, they will be a primary contributor for implementing and maintaining a broad array of training, communication, and outreach initiatives on behalf of PMO. This includes identifying educational strategies and property awareness opportunities for the PMO team, DPAs, and the campus community, including associated logistics support. They will regularly interact and collaborate with co-workers and represent PMO when providing guidance and direction, customer service, assistance, and leadership to DPAs and other University personnel.
  
  
Key elements for success in this role include having demonstrated knowledge of curriculum development and delivery of in-person, virtual, and self-guided training. Others include understanding equipment life cycle management concepts, accounting, industry standards and regulatory compliance, as well as PMO policies, procedures, and systems. Familiarity with the Stanford environment and culture is very helpful.

* Independently implement, administer and evaluate day-to-day activities of the unit, function or program by identifying and executing tasks and objectives, making recommendations that impact policies and programs, and assigning resources to achieve the goals of the program.
* Collect and analyze data, create reports, review and explain trends; formulate and evaluate alternative solutions and/or recommendations to achieve the goals of the program or function.
* Analyze and interpret policies; develop, revise and implement procedures for program or function.
* Represent the program or function as the key contact and subject matter expert within the department, unit or school. Commit resources and provide information and/or training. May also represent the program or function to external/internal stakeholders and constituencies.
* Organize and/or participate in outreach activities that may include developing communications and training, planning/promoting events and/or conferences.
* May participate in development of budgets, monitor, and approve expenditures. May perform limited forecasting and provide recommendations that determine the budget.
* May direct staff to perform various tasks and assignments. May also supervise staff.

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree and three years of relevant experience, or combination of education and relevant experience.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :

* Demonstrated ability to prioritize own work

jobs.description:
**Description**

**About us:**

For over three decades, Cirtec Medical has been a leading outsourcing partner for complex medical devices. We specialize in providing comprehensive solutions for Class II and III devices, from design and development to precision components and finished device assembly. Our expertise spans neuromodulation, implantable drug delivery, cardiac rhythm management, structural heart, mechanical circulatory support, and minimally invasive surgical systems.

Our dedicated teams prioritize growth, innovation, and collaboration. We actively seek opportunities for improvement to enhance our support for clients. If you embrace a growth mindset and thrive on challenges, you may be a perfect fit for our team!

**Position Summary:**

The Quality Manager will be responsible for the leadership and management of Quality personnel and resources to ensure compliance to Cirtec Medical’s Quality Management System. The Quality Manager may be the designated Management Representative for the Quality Management System. The Quality Manager will also be responsible for overseeing Quality engineering activities to support sustaining manufacturing operations, and product development programs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for oversight and compliance of the Quality Management System.
* Responsible for ensuring that the processes needed for the Quality System requirements are established and maintained in accordance with applicable regulations and standards.
* Responsible for ensuring the promotion and awareness of applicable regulatory requirements and Quality Management System requirements throughout the site’s organization.
* Responsible for leading Management Review meetings and reporting on the performance and effectiveness of the Quality System, as well as any improvements needed, for periodic review and analysis.
* Oversee Complaint Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Action Systems, and the tracking / reporting of metrics.
* Lead and manage the Quality Engineering staff responsible for Design & Development as well as Sustaining Manufacturing activities.
* Manage Quality Control staff to provide incoming (receiving & inspection), in-process inspection, final inspection, and product release activities for all manufacturing programs.
* Responsible for overseeing or delegating the creation of QMS related Quality Plans that are site-specific.
* Provide organizational leadership, coaching, mentoring and guidance to all Quality personnel as well as cross-functional teams.
* Drive and support corporate Quality Management System initiatives.
* In partnership with other Cirtec Medical Quality Leaders, ensure establishment and maintenance of site registrations (e.g., ISO 13485 and FDA).
* Act as site champion for Quality Best Practices and cGMP within Cirtec Medical.
* Ensure accountability for Design and Development management of internal and customer development programs and design transfers.
* Provide Quality Engineering support for internal and customer development programs and sustaining manufacturing process/continuous improvement efforts.
* Initiate and/or collaborate in the generation/update of process / product Risk Management documentation, e.g., FMEAs and Hazard Analysis, in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams.
* Develop and perform qualifications and validations for manufacturing processes in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams per project requirements.
* May author, review and/or approve documentation for process and design change activities as well as validation / verification oversight and/or test method execution in cooperation with cross-functional engineering teams per project requirements.
* Represent Quality Engineering in program / project phase reviews throughout the product development and transfer to manufacturing phases and process improvement initiatives.
* Support and oversee the Nonconformance Materials Review Board process.
* Manage metrology and calibration activities.
* Primary lead for external regulatory, certification, and customer audits.
* Manage support for local and corporate Documental Control (PLM) and Material Resource Planning (MRP) systems implementations, integrations, and improvements.
* Manage Quality Systems staff to provide Documentation Control and records retention functions, Incoming/Final Inspection, Complaint Analysis, Corrective Action System and Quality Control training to Customer Focused Business Units.

**Must Have:**

* Bachelor in STEM related field required. Advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of experience in a regulated medical device environment, preferably as a Sr. or Principal Quality Engineer or Quality Manager, with supervisory and decision-making responsibilities.
* Quality and/or Regulatory certification(s) (ASQ, Lead Auditor, etc.).
* Knowledge and experience with external standards and regulations: ISO 13485, and 21 CFR 820 (FDA cGMP/QSR), EU MDR, especially pertaining to product development, design controls, good manufacturing practices, supplier auditing & management, quality control (GD&T, MRB, etc.), CAPA and customer complaints.
* Experience with Class II and Class III medical device development and manufacturing.
* Demonstrable knowledge and experience with Manufacturing Process tools/methodologies including: Process Change Assessment, Risk Management (Hazard Analysis), Process FMEA, Statistical Analysis, Process Qualification, Gauge R&R, and Inspection/Test Method Validation.
* Experience in effectively managing audits by customers and regulatory agencies.
* Must be able to implement quality programs, interpret the collected data, and present the data to management to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to present complex information to internal and external contacts.
* Experience being a “Hands-on” self-starter with ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Training or equivalent exper

**Job Title:** Quality Manager

**Job Summary**

The Engineering Manager for the Quality Department oversees the Quality Engineering and Out-of-Box Audit (OBA) teams, ensuring that all manufacturing and product quality processes meet customer requirements, internal standards, and regulatory compliance. The Quality department is responsible for ensuring product quality throughout the manufacturing lifecycle, from New Product Introduction (NPI) and Mass Production (MP) support. jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary:**

The ARIA Non-Invasive Neurostimulation/Neuromodulation (NINM) Frontier Science Hub Initiative is a new multi-million dollar multi-year privately-funded endeavor in the Department of Psychiatry & Behavioral Sciences, led by Vice Chair for Research Dr. Andrew Krystal. This groundbreaking research program aims to advance scientific discovery and develop innovative NINM therapeutic opportunities for individuals with profound autism. As a high-profile, multi-institutional research venture, the ARIA NINM Frontier Science Hub spans a consortium of three leading universities—Yale, Stanford, and UCSF—and will support up to 15 new multi-site and department-based research programs. The initiative will involve complex financial structures, including numerous subawards, subcontracts, and the active engagement of dozens of faculty Principal Investigators.

**Custom Scope**

This position exists to serve as the strategic and operational leader responsible for ensuring the successful development, implementation, and management of the ARIA NINM Frontier Science Hub Initiative in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences. Acting as the senior administrative partner to faculty leadership, the incumbent provides oversight across all facets of program administration, ranging from high-level strategic planning to day-to-day operational management, including staff supervision and budget management. The incumbent drives long-term planning and program-wide strategies in collaboration with faculty leadership, identifying opportunities for growth, creating and refining policies and procedures, and aligning all efforts with the initiative’s overarching goals. Acting as a liaison across the consortium, the incumbent facilitates seamless communication and collaboration, attending regular consortium meetings and coordinating efforts with the advisory board, external agencies and funders to maintain compliance and foster strong relationships. The incumbent provides oversight of ARIA’s complex financial structures, including subawards and subcontracts, ensuring transparency, accountability, and efficient allocation of resources across diverse research programs. By partnering with faculty Principal Investigators, the incumbent supports the implementation and monitoring of individual research projects, offering strategic guidance on proposals and priorities to maximize the initiative’s impact. Additionally, the incumbent designs and implements workshops, conferences, and publication initiatives to disseminate research findings, foster collaboration, and elevate ARIA’s visibility within the scientific community and beyond. The incumbent must possess exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills to navigate the complexities of a multi-institutional research initiative. Additionally, expertise in financial management, staff supervision, policy development, and stakeholder engagement is critical to ensuring the Initiative’s success

**Department Overview**

The UCSF Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences (DPBS) is a leader in advancing mental health care, research, and education. The Department is among the nation’s foremost resources in the field of child, adolescent and adult mental health. Joining UCSF DPBS provides an opportunity to work alongside world-renowned experts in psychiatry, psychology, neuroscience, and behavioral sciences. Psychiatry faculty members are recognized for their leadership roles in state-of-the-art, comprehensive and compassionate patient care, pioneering research, excellence in training the next generation of leaders, advancing public policy to advance mental health, and commitment to diversity. jobs.title: Business Operations Lead, IDC
jobs.description:
IDC is the Infra team chartered to ensure data centers are designed and built to meet Meta's needs, and operated efficiently, reliably, and sustainably — working closely with Core Systems, Infra Foundation, NetInfra, and FinanceWe're seeking an Executive Business Operations Lead to serve as the strategic and operational backbone for IDC’s most senior leadership. This role operates at the intersection of organizational strategy, executive decision-making, and cross-company coordination — shaping how a multi-thousand-person organization plans, prioritizes, communicates, and delivers at scale.This role requires an experienced business operations executive who has operated as a trusted advisor to VP+ leaders in complex organizations. They bring sound business judgment informed by experience, enterprise-wide perspective, and the ability to architect scalable operating models that create clarity and alignment across multiple teams and workstreams. They have a track record of driving transformational initiatives, building high-performing operational functions, and operating with the discretion, credibility, and influence required to partner with VP and C-suite leadership.  
  
  

### **Business Operations Lead, IDC Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the end-to-end operating model for IDC’s executive leadership team — defining the cadence, structure, and decision-making frameworks that drive strategic alignment across multiple VP-led organizations
* Serve as a strategic advisor and thought partner to IDC’s VP+ leadership on organizational strategy, resource allocation, cross-functional dependencies, and enterprise-wide priorities
* Architect and lead the rhythm of the business for a multi-thousand person organization, ensuring leadership has line-of-sight into critical workstreams, risks, and investment decisions
* Drive transformational initiatives spanning organizational design, operating model changes, and cross-company coordination — scoping ambiguity, building alignment across senior stakeholders, and delivering measurable outcomes
* Lead executive communications strategy — shaping the narrative for IDC’s leadership across internal forums, company-wide presentations, board-level materials, and leadership offsites
* Build and codify scalable decision-making frameworks, executive review structures, and information architectures that enable leadership to operate with speed and clarity
* Operate as the enterprise-wide connective tissue across IDC's sub-organizations and key cross-functional partners (Finance, HR, Recruiting, Facilities, Legal) — identifying systemic gaps, driving resolution, and ensuring coherence across initiatives
* Mentor and develop business operations partners across the Infrastructure organization, elevating the craft and building a community of practice
* Represent IDC leadership in cross-company forums, executive reviews, and strategic working groups — synthesizing complex technical and organizational context for senior audiences
* Move to MINIMUM\_QUALIFICATION

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in business operations, strategy, management consulting, program management, or Chief of Staff roles in complex, technical organizations
* 5+ years of experience operating as a direct strategic partner to VP or C-suite executives in large organizations
* 5+ years of experience embedded in or closely partnering with engineering/infrastructure organizations, with demonstrated ability to translate technical complexity into strategic and operational clarity
* Track record of designing and implementing scalable operating models, governance structures, and decision-making frameworks at the enterprise level
* Proven ability to drive large-scale organizational transformations — including reorgs, operating model redesigns, and cross-company strategic initiatives — from conception through execution
* Experience crafting compelling narratives for VP/SVP/C-suite audiences across written, verbal, and presentation formats
* Demonstrated ability to build trust, credibility, and influence with senior executives while maintaining confidentiality on highly sensitive organizational and personnel matters
* Experience mentoring or managing business operations professionals and elevating operational excellence across an organization
* Experience applying quantitative, analytical, and systems-thinking approaches to drive data-informed decision-making

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building a business operations function from the ground up or significantly scaling an existing one
* MBA or advanced degree in business, finance, engineering, or a related field

* **School Year:** Monday–Friday (32 hrs/wk)

#### **Why This Role Matters**

Since 1891, Boys & Girls Clubs of San Francisco (BGCSF) has provided high-quality, community-based youth development services to youth in San Francisco. Our mission is to inspire and enable all young people, especially those from disadvantaged circumstances, to realize their full potential as productive, responsible, and caring citizens. We impact the lives of Club members, primarily ages 6 to 18, by focusing on academic success, healthy lifestyles, good character, community engagement, and job readiness with earning potential. We are nationally recognized for the high-quality of our programs and comprehensive approach to serving youth. Whether you’re joining our administrative team, a Clubhouse team, a school-based team, or our Camp Mendocino team, you’ll be surrounded by enthusiastic, talented, and passionate colleagues who wake up every day ready to inspire young people to reach their full potential.

#### **What You’ll Do**

As a Program Leader at our Carver Elementary School-Based Club, you will play a crucial developmental role in shaping the lives of youth in our community. Rooted in strong relationships with members, school faculty, and families, this role oversees department activities and manages groups of children. You will facilitate engaging after-school activities, design age-appropriate curriculum, manage positive youth behavior, and mentor participants while collaborating with colleagues to meet program goals.

* **Program Facilitation & Lesson Planning**  
  + Create, organize, and lead engaging after-school programs and activities for groups of approximately 10 youth participants.
  + Develop age-appropriate lesson plans and curriculum that promote personal growth, educational achievement, and character development.

  + Provide a safe, structured, and nurturing environment for all youth participants.
  + Serve as a positive role model and mentor, fostering self-esteem, goal-setting, and personal development.
  + Establish Clubhouse standards and expectations grounded in mutual respect between staff and the community served.
  + Apply positive behavior management and disciplinary skills to maintain high expectations in a high-paced environment.
* **Team Collaboration & Operations**  
  + Collaborate with junior-level colleagues to share best practices, ensure program targets are met, and support team cohesion.
  + Maintain operational systems, routines, and record-keeping in a fast-paced environment with continual distractions.

#### **What You Bring**

##### **Required**

* Minimum 2 years of youth development experience working with youth ages 6–18 in a youth development setting
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, positive relationships with youth and design engaging curriculum
* Strong positive behavior management and disciplinary skills while maintaining high expectations
* Excellent communication, organizational, and self-starter abilities
* Ability to create, implement, and maintain systems and procedures in a fast-paced environment

##### **Preferred**

* Educational background or completed coursework in Early Childhood Development, Education, or related fields
* Proven leadership or mentorship experience
* Current Red Cross First Aid/CPR certification (or ability to obtain within 90 days of employment)
* Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a 10-passenger vehicle
* Bilingual skills (highly encouraged)

#### **Physical Requirements**

* Must be able to lift 25 lbs.
* Must be able to stand for at least 2 hours consecutively.
* Must be able to sit at a computer workstation for long periods of time.

#### **Why BGCSF**

* Comprehensive Health Benefits + Employer Contributions
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP): In-Person Counseling + 24/7 Confidential Mental Health Support
* Education Assistance
* Pre-tax Transportation Savings Account
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
* Mandatory Summer + Winter Weeklong Organization-wide Closures
* Professional Development Opportunities

#### **Compensation**

The estimated wage range for this role is $24.00 – $25.00 per hour. Final compensation is determined based on a range of factors, including skill set, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. Candidates may be hired at the entry, mid, or top level of the range depending on qualifications and position requirements.

jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
**Customer Success Lead**

Hybrid (San Francisco, CA) Full-time

**About Alethios**

Alethios is a decentralized health research platform. We give researchers one place to build a protocol, manage participants, and integrate wearables and surveys, in real-time, so they can go from formulation to validation without the friction of traditional, site-based research. We're a mission-driven company, focused on lowering the barriers to human health research for both researchers and participants. And we're growing quickly: more studies, more researchers, more categories, every month.

We're looking for someone who cares about human health, sweats the details, builds things, and wants to be at a mission-driven company. This is the first hire in this function. You'll define what customer success means at Alethios, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Business Operations and Engineering.

**The role**

You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The bigger opportunity is what you build while doing it. We launch 5 to 10 studies a month and that number is growing fast. The tools you create, such as automated study-health monitoring, templated onboarding, or AI-assisted client reporting, are what will take it substantially higher without growing the team. The best people here make themselves more leveraged every month, and this role is designed for that.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

**What you'll do**

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization
* Monitor study health: enrollment pacing, participant compliance, data flow from surveys and wearables
* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates
* Coordinate with our distribution team on kit timing, client product receipt, and participant mailing
* Drive renewals and expansion: a great first study should become a second
* Build the machine: automated study-health dashboards, templated onboarding flows, self-serve client resources, AI-assisted reporting
* Be the voice of the customer to engineering: feed pain points and patterns back into the product roadmap

**Who you are**

* You're product-minded: you've built workflows, automations, or internal tools, and you reach for AI tooling by default
* You're health-focused, with either a serious hunger to learn and analyze data or a clinical/research background
* You prepare for every meeting: clients notice, and so do we
* You're organized under pressure: multiple concurrent studies won't rattle you
* You're creative: when the obvious process doesn't fit, you invent one that does

**Nice to have**

* Clinical credentials or a health sciences background
* Experience at an early-stage company where you built the function rather than inherited it
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or IRB submission tools

**Benefits**

We want our team to feel supported, in work and in life. Alethios offers:

* **Competitive compensation** including equity that reflects the value and impact you bring from day one
* **Health benefits**: we cover 100% of healthcare and dental plan premiums for employees
* **Generous PTO** so you can recharge fully and show up at your best
* **Mission-driven work** that directly lowers barriers to evidence generation and makes research more accessible
* **A dynamic team**: small and collaborative, where every voice matters and cross-disciplinary thinking shapes the product daily
* **SF office with flexibility**: this role is hybrid out of our San Francisco office

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94104
