SharePoint Implementation and Microsoft 365 Solutions SpecialistProfessional Summary

Experienced SharePoint and Microsoft 365 professional with a strong focus on **end-to-end SharePoint implementation, solution design, workflow automation, and business process improvement**. Skilled in analyzing business requirements, designing scalable SharePoint solutions, implementing and configuring SharePoint sites and components, and integrating Microsoft 365 technologies to improve operational efficiency, information management, and cross-functional collaboration. Experienced in SharePoint Online administration, governance, permissions management, security, migration, modernization, and ongoing production support. Proven ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, IT teams, and technical partners to translate business needs into effective, secure, and sustainable technology solutions aligned with organizational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* **SharePoint Implementation and Solution Delivery:** Lead and support end-to-end SharePoint implementations, including requirements gathering, solution architecture, site design, configuration, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and post-implementation support.
* **SharePoint Site Design and Development:** Design, build, configure, and maintain SharePoint Online sites, site collections, document libraries, lists, metadata, content types, forms, web parts, navigation, and collaboration solutions tailored to business requirements.
* **Business Requirements and Analysis:** Partner with business stakeholders and subject matter experts to gather, analyze, validate, and document requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications, technical designs, and implementation plans.
* **Workflow Automation:** Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain automated workflows using SharePoint, Power Automate, and related Microsoft 365 technologies to streamline approvals, notifications, document routing, task assignments, and business processes.
* **Business Process Optimization:** Evaluate existing business processes and SharePoint environments to identify inefficiencies, content management challenges, collaboration gaps, and automation opportunities; recommend and implement solutions that improve productivity and user experience.
* **SharePoint Governance and Security:** Establish and maintain SharePoint governance frameworks, standards, naming conventions, site provisioning procedures, lifecycle management practices, permission models, access controls, and external sharing policies in alignment with corporate security requirements.
* **SharePoint Environment Assessment:** Assess existing SharePoint environments, including site architecture, information structure, content organization, usage patterns, permissions, sharing configurations, and governance gaps; develop and execute recommendations for improvement.
* **Migration and Modernization:** Lead or participate in SharePoint migration, implementation, modernization, consolidation, and enhancement initiatives, supporting content migration, site restructuring, permissions validation, testing, and business continuity.
* **Microsoft 365 Integration and Administration:** Administer, configure, and support SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 services, including Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, Exchange Online, and Power Platform, to deliver integrated business solutions.
* **Documentation and Technical Specifications:** Develop and maintain functional and technical specifications, solution design documents, workflow diagrams, governance plans, implementation procedures, user guides, and operational documentation.
* **Testing and Deployment:** Perform functional testing, workflow validation, user acceptance testing coordination, issue resolution, deployment planning, and post-implementation validation to ensure SharePoint solutions meet business and technical requirements.
* **User Support and Troubleshooting:** Provide technical support, diagnose and resolve SharePoint and Microsoft 365 issues, manage access and permissions requests, and support ongoing maintenance and continuous improvement of implemented solutions.
* **Training and User Adoption:** Develop training materials, conduct demonstrations, and provide end-user guidance to promote adoption of SharePoint solutions, document management practices, automated workflows, and Microsoft 365 collaboration capabilities.
* **Stakeholder and Project Collaboration:** Serve as a liaison between business units, IT teams, project managers, vendors, and technical stakeholders to coordinate solution delivery, manage requirements, communicate implementation progress, and ensure alignment with business objectives.
* **Continuous Improvement and Technology Evaluation:** Monitor emerging SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and Power Platform capabilities; evaluate new features and recommend enhancements that strengthen governance, security, automation, scalability, and collaboration.

Core Technical Competencies

* SharePoint Online implementation and administration
* SharePoint site architecture, configuration, and customization
* SharePoint lists, libraries, metadata, content types, and permissions
* Power Automate workflow development and business process automation
* Microsoft 365 integration and administration
* Microsoft Teams and OneDrive collaboration solutions
* SharePoint governance, security, and access management
* SharePoint migration, modernization, and environment assessments
* Requirements analysis and functional and technical specifications
* Testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support
* User training, technical documentation, and change management
* Business process improvement and stakeholder engagement

Pay: $60.00 - $85.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: In person

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

.

.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Billing Operations Analyst.

We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey.

Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow.

Be the voice that makes someone’s day better.

At Nutrafol, our customers come to us during a vulnerable, sometimes emotional moment in their lives. How we show up for them, with empathy, expertise and a little creativity, is what sets us apart. **Company Overview:**

At myKaarma, we’re not just leading the way in fixed ops solutions for the automotive industry—we’re redefining what’s possible for dealership service centers. Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and powered by a global team, our industry-leading SaaS platform combines communication, scheduling, and payment tools in one seamless solution that keeps dealerships and vehicle owners connected. With myKaarma, every service interaction flows effortlessly, bringing good karma to customers and service teams.

Rooted in the principles of the Toyota Production System, we operate with precision, efficiency, and a relentless focus on continuous improvement to deliver a better experience for all. We’re looking for innovators, problem-solvers, and tech enthusiasts passionate about building solutions people love to use. If you’re ready to make an impact in an industry ripe for change, join us at myKaarma and help shape the future of automotive service.

At myKaarma, exceptional customer interactions are the cornerstone of our success. Our platform is meticulously engineered to communicate with customers at every aspect of the service, repair, and maintenance journey, ensuring positive and memorable experiences.

### **Role Description**

As an **Implementation Specialist** at myKaarma, you will own the technical configuration and implementation readiness of our service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection solutions. You will partner directly with automotive dealership customers to understand their service workflows, operational needs, existing technology, and integration dependencies—then translate those requirements into reliable, scalable solutions.

You will serve as a technical escalation resource throughout the implementation process, resolving complex configuration challenges, confirming infrastructure readiness, and testing the complete customer journey before training begins. Working closely with Deployment Managers and the Training Team, you will ensure each solution is fully configured and prepared for a successful launch. You will also develop documentation, templates, automations, and repeatable processes that improve implementation efficiency and create a consistent customer experience.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Guide automotive dealership customers through the setup of myKaarma’s service scheduling, digital check-in, and vehicle inspection tools, ensuring each solution is configured to support the dealership’s specific business needs.
* Lead detailed discovery sessions to understand each dealership’s current workflows, operating processes, and existing technology, including any systems that myKaarma will replace.
* Confirm that each assigned dealership has the required devices, network connectivity, and technical infrastructure in place well before implementation or onsite training begins.
* Test and demonstrate the configured solution with the customer before training, walking through the full service experience from appointment scheduling and customer arrival through vehicle inspection and service completion.
* Coordinate closely with the Deployment Manager and Training Team to communicate customer requirements, resolve configuration issues, and ensure each product is fully prepared for onsite or remote training.
* Develop templates, automations, and repeatable processes that make product setup more efficient, reduce manual administrative work, and allow more time for meaningful customer consultation.

### **Qualifications and Skills**

* 2+ years of experience in software implementation, deployment, customer onboarding, or a similar client-facing role.
* Experience working in automotive, Software as a Service (SaaS), or another technology-enabled service environment.
* Strong communication and customer consultation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into clear system requirements.
* Self-directed and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations, priorities, and deadlines.
* Comfortable using business tools such as Salesforce and Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Forms, and related applications.
* General understanding of software implementation processes and customer service best practices.

**Preferred/Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience working in automotive dealership service operations, such as service scheduling, customer check-in, repair orders, or vehicle inspections.
* Experience implementing or supporting software used by automotive dealerships.
* Familiarity with myKaarma products or similar dealership technology platforms.

*We know great candidates don't always match every requirement. If this role excites you and your experience aligns with many of the qualifications, we'd encourage you to apply. Skills can be learned—we also value curiosity, ownership, and a willingness to grow.*

**Total Rewards at myKaarma**

At myKaarma, we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that extends beyond the base salary. Our commitment to competitive compensation includes bonuses and benefits that support both personal and professional well-being:

* **Flexible Work Environment**: We embrace a high-performance, flexible structure that values freedom and responsibility. Our “Highly Aligned, Loosely Coupled” model empowers teams to innovate and continuously improve using data-driven insights.
* **Health and Wellness**: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits, along with wellness and telework stipends.
* **Time Off:** Generous vacation time to recharge and balance life outside work.
* **In-Office Perks:** Enjoy dog-friendly offices and unlimited snacks or refreshments onsite.

The starting salary range for this role is $69,135.00 - $86,419.00 USD per year, depending on experience and qualifications, reflecting our dedication to competitive industry compensation. Additional details about our Total Rewards package will be shared during recruitment.

**THE ROLE**

The Sales Operations Manager owns the commercial data, process and coordination behind the Alba Group's sales and account management teams. You make sure our CRM data is right, our sellers walk into client conversations with real importer insight, and our internal meetings happen on time with the right people in the room.

You work alongside our sales support coordinator, who handles day-to-day CRM updates. You own the standards, the processes and the analysis. You partner daily with the EVP Commercial, sales, account management, trade advisory, pricing, operations and implementation.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**CRM data management**

* Own the integrity of commercial data in HubSpot across all five brands: accounts, contacts, opportunities and activity.
* Set data standards and guide the sales support coordinator on day-to-day updates so records stay clean and complete.
* Audit data regularly, fix gaps and duplicates, and keep HubSpot aligned with Revenue Vessel.
* Run a weekly pipeline hygiene check for stale deals, missing next steps and past-due close dates, and send each seller their list.

**HubSpot dashboards and reporting**

* Build and maintain HubSpot dashboards and reports for sales, account management and leadership.
* Pull and interpret revenue reporting from Clarity / Power BI to support commercial reviews.

**Importer analysis and prospecting**

* Analyze importer activity using trade data and importer intelligence tools: volumes, ports, origins, commodities, current brokers and forwarders.
* Use advanced Excel and AI tools to work through large importer data sets quickly.
* Turn that analysis into clear inputs so sales and account management can build targeted client proposals.
* Build target prospect lists by vertical for the sellers and the LATAM SDR using importer data.
* Support prospect research and account planning with data on where each client or prospect is growing.

**Account management reporting**

* Run regular reports for account management to identify downtrending accounts as early as possible.
* Flag shifts in shipment volume, NR and activity so account managers can act before an account is lost.
* Pull shipment, spend and trend data for key-account quarterly business reviews (QBRs). Account managers remain responsible for building and presenting their QBR.
* Track account tiering, assignments and portfolio NR targets in the account management program.

**Proposal and RFP coordination**

* Own the proposal and RFP calendar so deadlines are visible and nothing is rushed.
* Gather inputs from pricing, freight forwarding, customs brokerage and trade advisory, and route them to the proposal owner on time.
* Maintain a library of approved proposal templates, service descriptions and client case studies.

**Process ownership**

* Help design, document and roll out commercial processes, from lead to quote to onboarding handoff.
* Keep process documents, playbooks and templates current as the business changes.
* Partner with pricing and implementation so handoffs are clean and nothing falls through the cracks.

**Internal meeting coordination**

* Serve as the internal connector between sales and the other groups: operations, trade advisory, pricing and implementation.
* Organize and schedule client prep meetings, internal reviews and pipeline calls well in advance, so nothing is last minute.
* Set agendas, confirm attendees and materials, and track follow-ups to completion.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Required**

* 5+ years in sales operations, revenue operations or commercial analytics in a B2B environment.
* Hands-on HubSpot experience, including building dashboards and reports and managing data quality.
* Experience with Revenue Vessel and with pulling reports from Clarity / Power BI.
* Strong analytical skills with data management and trade data tools.
* Advanced Excel: pivot tables, lookups, Power Query and building models from raw data.
* Proficient with AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT or Claude to speed up analysis, reporting and documentation.
* Highly organized. Comfortable coordinating meetings and calendars across several teams and senior leaders.
* Clear, concise communicator who can turn data into a story sales can use.
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, analytics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* Background in logistics, freight forwarding, customs brokerage or trade compliance.
* Experience with importer data and trade intelligence platforms.
* CargoWise and netCHB experience.
* Experience running account health or churn reporting.
* Spanish proficiency.

**HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED**

* Data quality: share of HubSpot records meeting data standards.
* Early warning: downtrending accounts flagged before NR loss compounds.
* Proposal support: importer analysis and proposal inputs delivered

jobs.description:

---------------

  

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

  

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

As a Program Manager, Professional Services, you will be the face of Stord as we grow our business and partnerships together with our customers. * Balance a number of internal and external priorities (i.e. customer business outcomes, resource limitations, tight timelines, evolving scope changes, milestone risks and project budget constraints) with discretion and thoughtfulness towards both customer and Stord goals

* Spearhead the design and execution of innovative technology solutions and implementation of new systems/processes for existing customers across our supply chain network, such as the deployment of new internal tools for employee use, or migrating customers from legacy systems to Stord software
* Provide feedback to refine, develop and evolve Stord’s service offering, solution design process, and onboarding process and experience for new customers
* Act as a culture warrior for Stord values, as well as an advocate for continuous improvement, by identifying opportunities and efficiencies in Supply Chain and across the organization

**What You'll Need:**

* Excellent communication skills (verbal, written), to communicate horizontally and vertically within the organization and externally to customer stakeholders, all with clarity, precision and succinctness
* Willingness to be a versatile team player that is comfortable under pressure, bold in asking for clarification when the requirement or action item is unclear, and unafraid to challenge assumptions or expectations that are unfounded
* The endless drive and resilience to remove barriers and enable teams to complete their objectives, and the charisma to lead and bring together members from functional, technical and operational to achieve program goals

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Specialist - Procurement Solutions
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Senior Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. This is a senior role on the Implementation team, suited to someone who has already worked in hospital pharmacy purchasing or cost-savings optimization, and can bring that domain depth directly into how our customers configure and adopt Procurement solutions.

As a senior member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly attentive to detail, comfortable talking with pharmacy buyers, purchasing directors, and finance stakeholders, and can operate in an environment that is often ambiguous and requires creativity to resolve issues.

* Act as the main point of contact for customers before they go live, owning all communications including weekly check-in meetings, ad hoc calls, and emails.
* Manage multiple implementation projects at once, across customers with different priorities, purchasing structures, and deadlines.
* Work as a consultative partner with customers' purchasing and pharmacy teams, advising on best practices for pharmacy cost-savings optimization, 340B compliance, and GPO/contract alignment.
* Train customer stakeholders on the CostCheck savings methodology and how to interpret savings-vs-cap performance so they're self-sufficient after go-live.
* Train customer stakeholders on the 340BCheck compliance and audit workflows within the system to provide them assistance in HRSA audits.
* Train customer stakeholders on ShortageCheck use and medication tracking.
* Act as a liaison between the customer, wholesalers/GPOs, and Bluesight's internal Clinical, Product, and Dev teams to facilitate technical and pricing configuration of the software.
* Maintain up-to-date project plans, tickets, and other project documentation so timelines stay on track and visible to leadership.
* Serve as a senior resource for the Implementation team on purchasing- and cost-related questions, helping onboard and support other Implementation Specialists.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to support rollout, meet with key stakeholders, and represent Bluesight professionally in front of customers.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, pharmacy, healthcare management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience, with a background aligned to hospital pharmacy purchasing, buying, procurement, or pharmacy cost-savings optimization (e.g., experience as a buyer or in a similar purchasing-facing role).
* 2+ years of project management and/or client-facing experience, ideally implementation-related.
* Strong familiarity with pharmacy cost savings programs, 340B program requirements, and group purchasing organizations (GPOs) preferred.
* Experience in the healthcare industry, ideally hospital pharmacy or health-system purchasing.

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy—proactively identifying important problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to the strategy and roadmap for cross-functional risk review. This role requires sound judgment, strategic thinking, and experience operating across multiple risk domains.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering large-scale programs, aligning solutions across multiple teams, and gaining recognition as a subject-matter expert whose advice is sought out across the product and risk community.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging

* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver time-sensitive, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing and driving strategy or roadmap for cross-functional projects and/or teams
Experience with product launches, 0* 1 products, emerging technologies, or novel product capabilities
* Background in triaging or adjudicating product-level risks, ideally in a platform or infrastructure context
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience working with AI agents, automation, or other emerging technologies to improve risk assessment and operational efficiency
* Comfort presenting risk perspectives to senior stakeholders and leading through ambiguity
* Understanding of regulatory, reputational, or policy risks related to consumer-facing technology
* Experience with consumer-facing technology, platforms, AI/ML products, infrastructure, or other technically complex products
* Experience working on privacy, content, legal, or compliance-related product issues
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

jobs.title: Patient Access Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.  
  
We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.  
  
At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

**About the job**

The Patient Access Coordinator is Vynca's front line — often the first voice a patient, family member, provider, or health plan hears. This role owns every inbound call and, separately, owns direct referrals end to end (from providers, hospitals, facilities, and community partners) through intake and prep, then hands the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach. MIF list referrals are out of scope for this role. The ideal candidate is warm and calm under pressure, catches clinical red flags, and keeps calls and referrals moving without anything falling through the cracks.  
  
*At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states with a strong preference for those EST based: California, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington.*

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, meeting call answer rate and service level targets, and flagging volume or staffing risks to the Shared Services Manager.
* Assess each caller's need and route or warm-transfer to the right department the first time; identify clinical trigger words and escalate to triage immediately per protocol.
* De-escalate distressed or upset callers, and know when to involve a supervisor or clinician.
* Own direct referrals end to end (providers, hospitals, facilities, community partners); MIF list referrals are out of scope.
* Complete intake for each direct referral — pre-admission assessment, scheduling support, and documentation — then hand off the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach.
* Document call and intake details accurately in real time; maintain databases, logs, census sheets, and contact lists.
* Manage voicemails, callback queues, and after-hours messages within established timeframes.
* Meet call handling and referral prep targets; follow scripts and quality standards; participate in coaching, team meetings, and huddles.
* Maintain strict HIPAA compliance, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Your experience and qualifications**

* Associate degree or medical/business office training highly preferred.
* 2+ years in a high call volume role (i.e call center, medical front office, patient access, and/or or intake/admissions).
* Healthcare experience required. *Experience in palliative care, home health, hospice, discharge planning, or safety-net hospital settings, highly preferred.*
* Proven de-escalation skills with distressed or grieving callers, and the judgment to know what to escalate.
* Ability to recognize clinical trigger words after training (no license required); clinical fluency from training or experience alongside SWs, RNs, MAs, chaplains, or scribes a plus.
* Strong multitasker across phone, documentation, and multiple systems; reliable attendance; comfortable with Google Workspace, Salesforce, telephony, and EHR systems.
* Cultural competency and working knowledge of HIPAA, with the ability to manage difficult conversations involving serious illness, grief, and/or end of life care.
* Willing and able to work Monday-Friday 8:30-5pm EST with occasional evenings/weekends.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) required.

We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

**About Picus**

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

The pioneer of Breach and Attack Simulation, Picus proves and improves the security controls you already own, doubling control effectiveness within three months. **Who We Are**

Robert Half, one of FORTUNE’s World’s Most Admired Companies and a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For is hiring for a **Customer Experience Analyst** to join the Marketing Customer Experience department.

The Customer Experience Analyst manages the day-to-day execution and analysis of Robert Half’s customer experience listening programs across client and candidate journeys. Responsibilities include administering surveys and feedback channels, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, developing reports and visualizations, and monitoring customer signals across multiple sources. Working with internal teams and external partners, the analyst helps test and improve listening programs and expand the use of automation, text analytics, and AI-assisted analysis. The analyst independently investigates customer experience trends, identifies emerging risks, and recommends improvements to listening programs and reporting processes.

**What You'll Do**

Customer Experience Analysis, Reporting, and Data Quality

* Own recurring customer experience reporting cycles, including data preparation, quality assurance, and development of summaries and materials for CX leadership to present.
* Independently analyze survey results, trends, and segments using appropriate statistical methods.
* Analyze open-text feedback using established coding frameworks, taxonomies, and validation rules.
* Create PowerPoint charts, tables and summaries that explain meaningful patterns, changes, and areas requiring deeper investigation.
* Use text analytics and artificial intelligence tools for theme identification and summarization, validating outputs against source data and established coding standards.
* Support report automation, dashboard maintenance, data-feed validation, and improvements to repeatable analysis and reporting processes.

Customer Experience Listening Program Execution

* Independently manage established customer experience survey programs, including programming, distributions, contact lists, suppression rules, workflows, and ongoing maintenance.
* Test survey links, logic, data capture, and workflow changes before launch and after major updates.
* Lead development, configuration, testing, monitoring, and analysis of digital intercepts in partnership with internal teams and external vendors.
* Engage with vendors and internal partners on troubleshooting, testing, and specialized program enhancements. Will maintain program documentation.

Customer Experience Signal Monitoring, Research, and Program Support

* Lead focus groups and individual interviews with clients and candidates through scheduling, notetaking, organization, and thematic synthesis.
* Conduct customer experience analysis and investigations to answer business questions and support decision-making.
* Monitor dashboards and structured and unstructured data sources for notable changes, emerging themes, and customer friction.
* Review reporting alerts and threshold changes, validate the signal, document findings, and share results with the appropriate team.
* Partner with Customer Experience, Design, Digital, Technology, Data, and other teams to support research and measurement initiatives.

**What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, research, analytics, social sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Previous work/professional experience (Type and # of years): 5+ years in customer experience, customer insights, survey research, market research, analytics, or related work.

Our mentor teacher model connects some of the country's most exceptional educators with teachers across the nation, equipping and inspiring them to deliver discourse-rich math and literature lessons that are rigorous, culturally responsive, and deeply engaging.

Through intensive pre-service training and dynamic weekly professional development sessions, our summer programming focuses on research-proven instructional practices that accelerate learning. We provide teachers and school leaders with the targeted support and hands-on practice needed to elevate their craft. Our core belief is simple: teachers get better faster by observing the best and practicing.

Our comprehensive approach combines daily exposure to excellent curriculum, observation of outstanding mentor teachers, targeted professional development to help teachers across the country improve rapidly and effectively, and exceptional operational support.

jobs.description:
**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Implementation team at Vividly plays a critical role in turning a customer's solution design into a successful, operational Vividly experience.

Our Implementation Managers are both **hands-on platform configurators and end-to-end project managers**. They take an approved solution design and translate it into Vividly configuration, customer workflows, data setup, training, testing, and ultimately go-live.

Implementation Managers serve as the primary point of contact throughout onboarding, coordinating across customers, Solution Architecture, Integrations, Managed Services, Customer Success, Product, and other internal teams to keep complex projects moving forward.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, understanding complex workflows, configuring software, managing multiple moving pieces, and creating an onboarding experience that gives customers confidence they made the right investment.

**Who You Are**

You are an energetic, curious, and highly accountable implementation professional who enjoys being in front of customers as much as you enjoy getting into the details of how a platform should be configured.

You're comfortable taking an approved solution design, understanding the business intent behind it, and turning it into something real. You can work through complex business workflows, translate requirements into accurate platform configuration, work confidently with customer data, and explain how the resulting experience will work for the people using it.

You're also a strong project manager. You can manage multiple implementations at once, keep customers and internal teams accountable, identify dependencies before they become blockers, and create momentum without sacrificing quality.

You don't need to design every solution from scratch, but you do need to understand the solution you're implementing. You ask questions when something doesn't make sense, recognize when customer requirements have materially changed, challenge assumptions when appropriate, and know when to bring Solution Architecture back into the conversation before changes create unnecessary complexity, scope creep, or rework.

Most importantly, you bring energy to the customer experience. You're engaged, passionate about helping customers succeed, comfortable leading a room, and genuinely enjoy seeing customers move from complicated processes to confidently operating in Vividly.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Business Operations & Analytics
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**Why We Exist**

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

**Why We’re Hiring**

Our Business Operations & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

* Growth Marketing
* Product Development
* AI & Automation
* Strategic Partnerships

**On leveling:** You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

**Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here**

* **No slides:** If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
* **No corporate fluff:** The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
* **Hands-on:** This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

**What You'll Own**

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

* **Define the right problems:** Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.

jobs.title: Product Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**OUR MISSION**
---------------

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. That only happens when the people using our tools understand them, trust them, and have a clear path to get help when something isn't working. Strong product operations is how we close the gap between what we build and how it's used every day.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

We're hiring a Product Operations Lead to make sure the software we build works well for the people who use it, from the day a feature ships and every day after. Thyme Care runs on three software platforms. The largest, Thyme Box, is the care management platform where our nurses, social workers, care partners, nurse practitioners, and medical directors spend their day. You'll connect our product and engineering teams with the care team: you'll know how our products work in practice, spot problems early, and make sure changes land smoothly.

The work is broad. It covers first-line triage and user support, rollout planning, training and documentation, usage monitoring, and the operating rhythm of the product organization. Many of these processes exist informally today, and you'll have room to formalize and improve them. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineering, quality engineering, data science, service design, our training team, and Care Delivery and Enrollment operations.

Additionally, you will:

* **Become the expert on how our products work:** learn all three of our platforms and the key data assets behind them in depth, give introductory demos to new team members across tech and the broader company, and be a go-to resource when someone needs to understand how something works
* **Serve as first-line triage for Thyme Box issues:** partner with Quality Engineering on bug triage, field reports from the care team, ask the clarifying questions that separate "the product works differently than I expected" from "something is broken," and hand off well-documented issues for technical investigation
* **Run product rollouts:** partner with PMs and engineering to plan and project manage feature pilots and rollouts with Care Delivery and Enrollment operations, provide first-line support to end users as changes go live, and own release notes and cross-functional communications and training materials for upcoming releases
* **Support quality before launch:** help QA new features across engineering and service design pods, and set up in-product walkthroughs and tooltips for new functionality
* **Keep training and documentation accurate:** own the accuracy of Thyme Box training documentation and reference materials; partner with our training team on new hire onboarding and refresher materials for the care team; and review other training materials and process changes for how they interact with Thyme Box, recommending ways to streamline those processes in the tool
* **Monitor usage and listen to users:** use tools and data analysis to spot unusual Thyme Box usage patterns and flag them to the right teams, and run regular user satisfaction surveys, turning results into clear findings that product teams can act on
* **Keep product teams close to the care team:** coordinate regular shadowing sessions so product, engineering, and data science see their users' work firsthand, and create documents, videos, and other materials that explain to the care team how our tech teams work and how they can contribute
* **Run the product org's operating rhythm:** maintain a current product roadmap deck across all pods by gathering inputs from each PM, and own the product process calendar, including quarterly roadmap planning, vendor renewals, tech debt days, hackathons, and other recurring milestones
* **Use AI to work more efficiently:** apply AI tools to drafting documentation, analyzing survey and usage data, and building training materials

**WHAT YOU'VE DONE**
--------------------

* 3+ years in product operations, product support, implementation, training, or a similar role working closely with product and engineering teams on software used by operational teams
* Healthcare experience, especially in care delivery, digital health, or value-based care
* Experience acting as the bridge between end users and technical teams, including triaging issues and writing clear, reproducible bug reports
* Track record of planning and running software rollouts, including training, communications, and user support through launch
* Experience creating training materials, documentation, or user guides that people actually use and that drive successful feature adoption
* Comfort working with data: you can use monitoring or analytics tools, pull together usage data, and explain what you're seeing to non-technical audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to keep many recurring processes and deadlines on track at once

This role offers broad exposure across HR and is a strong path toward HR Business Partnering.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy explaining complex solutions in a way that everybody gets excited? If so, read on!

**About Picus**

Picus Security is an exposure validation company. One platform proves what attackers can exploit and what your defenses stop, turning every exposure into a defensible decision, autonomously and at the machine speed today's AI threats demand.

Picus validates attack surfaces, exposures, and security controls as one continuous loop: validate, decide, fix, re-validate. Instead of ranking findings by severity score, Picus proves which exposures are genuinely exploitable in your environment, including the business-critical, restricted, and air-gapped assets a live exploit can never safely touch, so teams act on what truly matters and resolve each exposure into a clear call to patch, mitigate, monitor, or accept with evidence.

The Picus Platform spans Autonomous Penetration Testing, Exposure Validation, and Breach and Attack Simulation, unified by Picus Swarm, a swarm of AI agents that runs the whole validation loop continuously. It reaches across on-prem, hybrid cloud, and endpoint environments, with 75+ integrations that ingest from scanners like Tenable and Wiz and operationalize through your EDR, SIEM, firewall, and ticketing tools.

new_jobs.title: Research Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About AfterQuery**
====================

AfterQuery is an applied research lab curating data solutions for foundation model development. We serve every frontier AI lab with the mission of delivering the best data to power the best models. In doing so, we can make expertise that once took a lifetime to build available to anyone who needs it.

Our customers are the ones building the foundation models themselves and our work sits directly in the loop of how those systems improve. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at a defining moment in AI. Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation. We're based in San Francisco and backed by leading investors including Altos Ventures, BoxGroup, and Y Combinator and angels from Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta Superintelligence Labs, and Microsoft AI.

**Why Apply**
=============

**Massive Opportunity:** Forbes reported that we could be YC's fastest unicorn, reportedly raising at a $3.2 billion valuation, and we're not slowing down.

**Founding Impact:** You will own and architect core infrastructure systems that power our platform from the ground up.

**Equity & Growth:** Competitive salary and meaningful equity. As we scale, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the engineering organization and lead major technical initiatives.

**Strong Team:** Our founding team has experience from Citadel Securities, Meta, Google, Silver Lake, and Morgan Stanley — work alongside world-class engineers and researchers.

**Overview**
------------

AfterQuery is hiring a Research Program Manager to run the operations behind its research programs: public benchmark releases, collaborations with academic and industry partners, and the research roadmap. You own the coordination, external relationships, and progress tracking that keep the program moving, and you are welcome to contribute to the research itself, from benchmark design to co-authoring publications.

This is a technical, hands-on role, not a pure coordination one. You will read results tables, run evals, sanity-check numbers before they go public, and turn loosely specified research needs into engineering and operational roadmaps. You will also be the program's voice to external partners, so clear writing and confident communication across researchers, executives, and academics are as important as technical fluency. You work daily with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and go-to-market partners.

--------------------

* Track progress across all active research projects. Anticipate resourcing gaps and technical bottlenecks, unblock projects that fall behind, and escalate with a clear recommendation when a timeline or scope needs to change.
* Coordinate the expert pool for upcoming benchmarks: forecast expert needs, manage capacity, and keep contributor logistics running.
* Write the program's external and internal communications: launch briefs, partner updates, planning documents, and status memos that turn technical detail into clear, actionable summaries.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 1-3+ years in research operations, technical program management, or a similar role in a fast-moving research or engineering organization.
* Technical background in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field, with working Python and SQL.
* Evaluation literacy: you have taken part in evaluating a product, an agent, or a foundation model, can read a results table, and can tell when a number should not be trusted.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You can distill a technical result into a summary a partner, executive, or academic collaborator can act on, and you write documents people actually read.
* A track record of running cross-functional programs end to end, including managing external partners, contractors, or collaborators.
* Comfort with ambiguity and building processes from scratch, and the judgment to keep processes light so researchers stay effective.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Graduate degree or research experience in a technical field.
* Contributed to a benchmark, dataset, or evaluation project in any role.
* Familiarity with public leaderboards or open research communities.
* Exposure to programs with external partners, such as fellowships, grants, or academic collaborations.
* Exposure to expert or annotator pools, or other human-data work.
* Comfort with lightweight dashboards or building small tools with AI assistants.

**Company Benefits (For Eligible Employees):**
----------------------------------------------

* Health Insurance: Medical, Vision, Dental
* 401(k) with Employer Match
* Daily Meals: Daily UberEats Stipend
* Monthly Wellness Stipend

**Company Overview**

Promex Industries specializes in custom assembly processes focusing on complex microelectronics and small component assemblies that require precise fabrication. With a longstanding presence in Silicon Valley, Promex offers a fully integrated, US-based facility dedicated to supporting biotech instrument and medical device companies from prototype to full-scale production.

**Position Summary:**

The Quality Assurance Technician supports and maintains the company's Quality Management System (QMS). The Technician administers the training and calibration programs, maintains controlled quality records, supports internal and external audits, and helps drive nonconformance, corrective action and quality data activities to closure. Working alongside the QC Inspector, the Technician applies inspection expertise (IPC workmanship standards, sampling plans and precision measurement) to support incoming and outgoing inspection, resolve acceptance questions and provide inspection backup when needed.

**Essential Duties:**

**QMS Operational Support**

· Administer the calibration program: maintain the equipment list and recall schedule, coordinate outside calibration vendors, review calibration certificates for acceptability, perform and record in-house verifications, and quarantine and report out-of-tolerance equipment.

· Maintain the training program, including the training matrix by position, the training schedule, and tracking of due, overdue and recurring training and re-qualifications.

· Schedule and coordinate training sessions with internal trainers, department supervisors and outside providers; notify employees and supervisors of upcoming and overdue training.

· Prepare for and support internal, customer and registrar audits by retrieving records, demonstrating processes and following up on findings.

· Document nonconforming material (NCMR), support MRB disposition, and gather objective evidence for corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) and supplier corrective actions (SCAR); track actions to closure.

· Collect, check and verify quality records to ensure the activities are completed as planned.

· Conduct ESD, 5S and in-process audit.

· Support material compliance management and compile compliance reports per guidance

**Inspection**

· Serve as technical resource to the QC Inspectors and operators on borderline acceptance questions.

· Conduct incoming, in-process and outgoing inspection of purchased materials and SMT assemblies to IPC-A-600/IPC-A-610, drawings and customer requirements.

· Perform specialized measurements using a Micro-Vu (or equivalent) vision measuring system, calipers, micrometers, gauges and microscopes, X-ray imaging, and XRF for plating thickness and RoHS/material verification.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

· High school diploma or GED.

· 5+ years of working experience and 3+ years of quality experience in an electronics manufacturing (SMT/PCBA) environment, including support of QMS operation.

· Working knowledge of IPC-A-610; familiarity with IPC J-STD-001 and IPC-A-600.

· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook, with accurate data entry.

· Working knowledge of QMS requirements (e.g., ISO 9001) for training, calibration, document control and records.

· Understanding of attribute sampling plans (ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 and c=0) and basic calibration concepts (traceability, tolerance, recall intervals).

· Hands-on experience with precision measuring tools (calipers, micrometers, gauges) and inspection microscopes

· Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, BOMs and specifications.

**Key Competencies:**

· **Organization & Follow-Through:** Manages schedules, due dates and recalls so that training and calibration never lapse, and follows open items to closure.

· **Computer Literacy:** Familiar with Microsoft Office, QMS software and other applications for record maintenance; learns new systems quickly.

· **Technical Judgment:** Applies acceptance criteria consistently and escalates borderline conditions appropriately.

· **Documentation Discipline:** Keeps records complete, accurate, legible and on time.

· **Attention to Detail:** Catches gaps and errors in records as well as workmanship and dimensional defects.

· **Communication:** Follows up clearly with employees, supervisors, vendors and the QC Inspector on training, calibration, inspection and corrective action items.

· **Integrity & Independence:** Holds the line on quality requirements under schedule pressure.

**Preferred Skills:**

· Associate degree or technical certificate in electronics, manufacturing or quality technology.

· Current IPC-A-610 Certified IPC Specialist (CIS); J-STD-001 certification a plus.

· Experience in an ISO 13485 or AS9100 quality system, including participation in audits.

· Experience with a Micro-Vu or other vision/CMM measuring system, and with XRF, X-ray or AOI inspection equipment.

· Experience in MIL-STD-883 optical inspection.

**Work Environment:**

· Combination of quality office and manufacturing/inspection-lab environment, including ESD-controlled areas and cleanrooms; requires wearing ESD/cleanroom equipment.

At Stanford University, not only are you part of an exceptional team that values innovation and education, but you also become part of a culture that brings out the best in you. Stanford is committed to fostering a workplace culture that promotes diversity, collaboration, and professional growth. Our culture offers career development programs, competitive pay that reflects market trends and benefits that increase financial stability and promote healthy, fulfilling lives.

Research—the creation of new knowledge—is key to Stanford’s educational mission. Stanford research has led to breakthrough remedies, devices, tools, and concepts, and hundreds of initiatives solely for the betterment of humanity. Among the inventions and discoveries that have resulted from Stanford research are MRI technology, DNA cloning, the Pill, heart transplantation, and digital music.

**Customer Success Lead**

Hybrid (San Francisco, CA) Full-time

**About Alethios**

Alethios is a decentralized health research platform. We give researchers one place to build a protocol, manage participants, and integrate wearables and surveys, in real-time, so they can go from formulation to validation without the friction of traditional, site-based research. We're a mission-driven company, focused on lowering the barriers to human health research for both researchers and participants. And we're growing quickly: more studies, more researchers, more categories, every month.

We're looking for someone who cares about human health, sweats the details, builds things, and wants to be at a mission-driven company. This is the first hire in this function. You'll define what customer success means at Alethios, reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Business Operations and Engineering.

**The role**

You'll own customer success end to end: study startup, go-live, and study ops. Day-to-day, that means working directly with researchers and sponsors to get their studies launched and run well.

The bigger opportunity is what you build while doing it. We launch 5 to 10 studies a month and that number is growing fast. The tools you create, such as automated study-health monitoring, templated onboarding, or AI-assisted client reporting, are what will take it substantially higher without growing the team. The best people here make themselves more leveraged every month, and this role is designed for that.

The work comes down to four things: relationship management, tool building, excellent follow-through, and both an instinct and an analytic approach for what makes a great study.

**What you'll do**

* Run study kickoff and onboarding: offer input on protocol digitization and study decentralization
* Monitor study health: enrollment pacing, participant compliance, data flow from surveys and wearables
* Own the client communication cadence: status updates, mid-study check-ins, results walkthroughs. Build the systems that generate these updates
* Coordinate with our distribution team on kit timing, client product receipt, and participant mailing
* Drive renewals and expansion: a great first study should become a second
* Build the machine: automated study-health dashboards, templated onboarding flows, self-serve client resources, AI-assisted reporting
* Be the voice of the customer to engineering: feed pain points and patterns back into the product roadmap

**Who you are**

* You're product-minded: you've built workflows, automations, or internal tools, and you reach for AI tooling by default
* You're health-focused, with either a serious hunger to learn and analyze data or a clinical/research background
* You prepare for every meeting: clients notice, and so do we
* You're organized under pressure: multiple concurrent studies won't rattle you
* You're creative: when the obvious process doesn't fit, you invent one that does

**Nice to have**

* Clinical credentials or a health sciences background
* Experience at an early-stage company where you built the function rather than inherited it
* Familiarity with HubSpot, Intercom, or IRB submission tools

**Benefits**

We want our team to feel supported, in work and in life. Alethios offers:

* **Competitive compensation** including equity that reflects the value and impact you bring from day one
* **Health benefits**: we cover 100% of healthcare and dental plan premiums for employees
* **Generous PTO** so you can recharge fully and show up at your best
* **Mission-driven work** that directly lowers barriers to evidence generation and makes research more accessible
* **A dynamic team**: small and collaborative, where every voice matters and cross-disciplinary thinking shapes the product daily
* **SF office with flexibility**: this role is hybrid out of our San Francisco office

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94104

Grafana Labs is looking for a Sales Operations Manager to support our GTM organization by managing advanced models, improving our data structure, and strengthening our operational processes. Reporting to the Sr Director of Field Operations, this role will focus on target setting, quota creation, and reporting for our consumption based product suite.

### **What Makes You a Great Fit:**

* 4+ years of experience in strategy and operations, consulting, business analytics, or compensation.
* Comfort working with large datasets and ambiguous problems, with the ability to distill key takeaways.
* Strong problem-solving skills – able to translate business challenges into structured models and insights.
* Excellent communication skills with executive audiences - explain “what it is”, “why it matters” and “what should we do” in terms of your data and analysis.
* Ability to work independently and drive analysis with minimal guidance.
* Expert-level Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data visualization.
* Proficiency in SQL and data orchestration between BigQuery and GTM tools
* Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, validation rules, and flows.
* Experience with compensation tools like Xactly, Apttus, or CaptivateIQ

### **Bonus Points For:**

* Previous experience in open source

new_jobs.title: Patient Access Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.  
  
We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.  
  
At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

**About the job**

The Patient Access Coordinator is Vynca's front line — often the first voice a patient, family member, provider, or health plan hears. This role owns every inbound call and, separately, owns direct referrals end to end (from providers, hospitals, facilities, and community partners) through intake and prep, then hands the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach. MIF list referrals are out of scope for this role. The ideal candidate is warm and calm under pressure, catches clinical red flags, and keeps calls and referrals moving without anything falling through the cracks.  
  
*At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states with a strong preference for those EST based: California, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington.*

**What you'll do**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, meeting call answer rate and service level targets, and flagging volume or staffing risks to the Shared Services Manager.
* Assess each caller's need and route or warm-transfer to the right department the first time; identify clinical trigger words and escalate to triage immediately per protocol.
* De-escalate distressed or upset callers, and know when to involve a supervisor or clinician.
* Own direct referrals end to end (providers, hospitals, facilities, community partners); MIF list referrals are out of scope.
* Complete intake for each direct referral — pre-admission assessment, scheduling support, and documentation — then hand off the fully prepped referral to EMA for direct outreach.
* Document call and intake details accurately in real time; maintain databases, logs, census sheets, and contact lists.
* Manage voicemails, callback queues, and after-hours messages within established timeframes.
* Meet call handling and referral prep targets; follow scripts and quality standards; participate in coaching, team meetings, and huddles.
* Maintain strict HIPAA compliance, and perform other duties as assigned.

**Your experience and qualifications**

* Associate degree or medical/business office training highly preferred.
* 2+ years in a high call volume role (i.e call center, medical front office, patient access, and/or or intake/admissions).
* Healthcare experience required. *Experience in palliative care, home health, hospice, discharge planning, or safety-net hospital settings, highly preferred.*
* Proven de-escalation skills with distressed or grieving callers, and the judgment to know what to escalate.
* Ability to recognize clinical trigger words after training (no license required); clinical fluency from training or experience alongside SWs, RNs, MAs, chaplains, or scribes a plus.
* Strong multitasker across phone, documentation, and multiple systems; reliable attendance; comfortable with Google Workspace, Salesforce, telephony, and EHR systems.
* Cultural competency and working knowledge of HIPAA, with the ability to manage difficult conversations involving serious illness, grief, and/or end of life care.
* Willing and able to work Monday-Friday 8:30-5pm EST with occasional evenings/weekends.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) required.

**✨ Real Impact, Real People:** Our mission at Point is to make homeownership more valuable and accessible. Your work directly helps homeowners access their wealth, achieve financial flexibility, and realize life changing goals.

**✨ Funding:** With over $175M raised from top investors like Andreessen Horowitz, WestCap, Greylock, and Prudential, we're scaling fast! You have the opportunity to join us at a pivotal stage.

**✨ Game-changing Product:** We're building a category defining company in home equity. We've earned a 4.7 Trustpilot rating and an A+ from the BBB, a testament to the value we provide to our 20,000+ customers.

**✨ Great Place to Work:** Our employees love working here! We are a Certified Great Place to Work and a Fortune Best Workplaces in the Bay Area.

**✨ Remote First Culture, Genuine Connection:** Work from anywhere in the U.S. while staying closely connected through virtual collaboration, team gatherings, and a people-first culture. Select roles may require onsite work at our Palo Alto office one day per week.

  

**Local or 100% Remote**

  

**About the role**

As a Servicing Operations Coordinator II at Point, you'll help homeowners navigate their Home Equity Investments (HEIs), providing clear, empathetic support and resolving complex servicing requests. From payoff inquiries and property sales to appraisal reviews and title-related questions, you'll coordinate with homeowners, external partners, and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely resolutions.

This role combines customer service, document review, and problem-solving. You'll take ownership of servicing issues, maintain accurate records, and help improve workflows as our operations evolve. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to balance operational efficiency with a positive homeowner experience.

  

**Your responsibilities**

* Respond to homeowner inquiries regarding Home Equity Investments via phone, email, and internal servicing channels with professionalism, empathy, and accuracy.
* Handle more complex or escalated homeowner servicing requests, including payoff inquiries, appraisal reviews, title-related questions, sales transaction coordination, and servicing disputes.
* Make outbound calls to homeowners, real estate agents, escrow/title companies, insurance providers, and local counties as necessary to resolve servicing matters.
* Review and process HEI-related servicing documentation, including valuation reports, sales contracts, payoff requests, insurance documents, authorization forms, and other servicing records.
* Analyze sales contracts, appraisals, title information, and supporting documentation for accuracy, completeness, and servicing risk considerations.
* Support payoff and property sale workflows while ensuring adherence to servicing timelines and operational requirements.
* Assist homeowners facing financial or operational challenges with empathy, professionalism, and strong customer service.
* Investigate and resolve servicing exceptions, discrepancies, and operational issues with minimal supervision.
* Help identify process improvement opportunities and provide feedback on servicing workflows, tooling, and operational efficiencies.
* Utilize Point's proprietary servicing systems and operational tools to maintain accurate servicing records and ensure proper documentation.

  

**About you**

* Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to work independently, solve problems, and use available resources effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, with confidence supporting homeowners by phone and email through both routine questions and escalated situations.
* A customer-focused, solutions-oriented approach that balances operational efficiency with empathy and a positive homeowner experience.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex servicing situations in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* Collaborative and able to work effectively across teams to resolve issues and support homeowners.
* Curious and proactive in identifying knowledge gaps, training needs, and opportunities to improve servicing quality and workflows.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.

**Nice to have**

* College degree in business, finance, or a related field preferred.
