**Vividly** is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. new_jobs.title: Senior Associate, Business Operations & Analytics
new_jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
new_jobs.description:
**Why We Exist**

Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all. We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace.

We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, scaled revenue 70X, and became profitable in early 2024. We're now expanding into adjacent verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, etc) to become the one-stop-shop for all your physical assets.

**Why We’re Hiring**

Our Business Operations & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

* Growth Marketing
* Product Development
* AI & Automation
* Strategic Partnerships

**On leveling:** You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

**Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here**

* **No slides:** If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.
* **No corporate fluff:** The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.
* **Hands-on:** This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

**What You'll Own**

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

* **Define the right problems:** Before any analysis, understand what business question it's answering and what decision it will inform. Push back if the question is flawed.
* **Data and insights:** Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.
* **Drive outcomes:** Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

**Who You Are**

* **First principles thinker:** You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"
* **Direct communicator:** You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.
* **Owner:** You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

**What You'll Bring**

* 2+ years of experience at a consulting firm, investment bank, or high-growth technology company.
* Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.
* Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.
* Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

**Our Tools**

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

*While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.*

***Please note:*** ***Jerry.ai*** ***is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.***

*Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.*

*Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at* *recruiting@jerry.ai*

*The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range li

new_jobs.title: Product Operations Lead
new_jobs.description:
**OUR MISSION**
---------------

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. That only happens when the people using our tools understand them, trust them, and have a clear path to get help when something isn't working. Strong product operations is how we close the gap between what we build and how it's used every day.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

We're hiring a Product Operations Lead to make sure the software we build works well for the people who use it, from the day a feature ships and every day after. Thyme Care runs on three software platforms. The largest, Thyme Box, is the care management platform where our nurses, social workers, care partners, nurse practitioners, and medical directors spend their day. You'll connect our product and engineering teams with the care team: you'll know how our products work in practice, spot problems early, and make sure changes land smoothly.

The work is broad. It covers first-line triage and user support, rollout planning, training and documentation, usage monitoring, and the operating rhythm of the product organization. Many of these processes exist informally today, and you'll have room to formalize and improve them. You'll partner closely with product managers, engineering, quality engineering, data science, service design, our training team, and Care Delivery and Enrollment operations.

Additionally, you will:

* **Become the expert on how our products work:** learn all three of our platforms and the key data assets behind them in depth, give introductory demos to new team members across tech and the broader company, and be a go-to resource when someone needs to understand how something works
* **Serve as first-line triage for Thyme Box issues:** partner with Quality Engineering on bug triage, field reports from the care team, ask the clarifying questions that separate "the product works differently than I expected" from "something is broken," and hand off well-documented issues for technical investigation
* **Run product rollouts:** partner with PMs and engineering to plan and project manage feature pilots and rollouts with Care Delivery and Enrollment operations, provide first-line support to end users as changes go live, and own release notes and cross-functional communications and training materials for upcoming releases
* **Support quality before launch:** help QA new features across engineering and service design pods, and set up in-product walkthroughs and tooltips for new functionality
* **Keep training and documentation accurate:** own the accuracy of Thyme Box training documentation and reference materials; partner with our training team on new hire onboarding and refresher materials for the care team; and review other training materials and process changes for how they interact with Thyme Box, recommending ways to streamline those processes in the tool
* **Monitor usage and listen to users:** use tools and data analysis to spot unusual Thyme Box usage patterns and flag them to the right teams, and run regular user satisfaction surveys, turning results into clear findings that product teams can act on
* **Keep product teams close to the care team:** coordinate regular shadowing sessions so product, engineering, and data science see their users' work firsthand, and create documents, videos, and other materials that explain to the care team how our tech teams work and how they can contribute
* **Run the product org's operating rhythm:** maintain a current product roadmap deck across all pods by gathering inputs from each PM, and own the product process calendar, including quarterly roadmap planning, vendor renewals, tech debt days, hackathons, and other recurring milestones
* **Use AI to work more efficiently:** apply AI tools to drafting documentation, analyzing survey and usage data, and building training materials

**WHAT YOU'VE DONE**
--------------------

* 3+ years in product operations, product support, implementation, training, or a similar role working closely with product and engineering teams on software used by operational teams
* Healthcare experience, especially in care delivery, digital health, or value-based care
* Experience acting as the bridge between end users and technical teams, including triaging issues and writing clear, reproducible bug reports
* Track record of planning and running software rollouts, including training, communications, and user support through launch
* Experience creating training materials, documentation, or user guides that people actually use and that drive successful feature adoption
* Comfort working with data: you can use monitoring or analytics tools, pull together usage data, and explain what you're seeing to non-technical audiences
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to keep many recurring processes and deadlines on track at once
* Strong

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. The Contact Center Representative provides personalized, accurate support to members by responding to inquiries and resolving a wide range of service-related needs. This role facilitates a positive member experience by clearly explaining product offerings, policies, and procedures while advancing member understanding and satisfaction. The representative performs research, analyzes member information, and resolves transactions within established guidelines. Strong communication, problem‑solving, and de‑escalation skills are essential to ensuring timely and effective outcomes. * Respond to Contact Center inquiries by delivering personalized service and accurate product information using multiple computer and telecommunications systems.
* Research, analyze, and resolve member transactions, including eligibility determinations, approvals, and communication of resolutions within established guidelines.
* Monitor, track, and follow up on assigned work, prepare customized correspondence, make outbound calls, and escalate issues when service timeframes cannot be met.
* Apply problem‑solving and de‑escalation techniques to address complex service issues and enhance the overall member experience.

Experience facilitating work and leading or coordinating with teams

new_jobs.title: HR Generalist
new_jobs.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow’s Employee Service Center (ESC) delivers fast, accurate and scalable HR support to a distributed workforce. It owns HR transactions, data integrity and compliance, and partners with People Product and HR COEs on digital solutions. We’re growing our HR Generalist team to own work that is too complex for core ESC support but doesn’t require full HRBP ownership. This work often involves nuanced judgment, manager coaching, data processing and interpretation, and cross-functional coordination across the People Org to support cyclical processes such as performance management, annual review, and recruiting. This role offers broad exposure across HR and is a strong path toward HR Business Partnering.

**About the role**
------------------

The HR Generalist serves an important role for the organization as a link between ESC operations and HR Business Partners (HRBPs). You’ll take in, sort and resolve routine but nuanced HR work: manager coaching, performance management, annual review, and project support across multiple areas.

  

You will get to:

* Serve as a frontline point of contact for managers, coaching them through nuanced HR questions with guidance based on policy, practice and risk.
* Run detailed inquiries with employees and ask the right follow-up questions to gather the facts, timeline, and route it to the right team to support.
* Partner with HRBPs to execute people and talent strategies, including performance, annual review, and position management efforts, ensuring operational details are managed end-to-end.
* Participate in HRBP team meetings, talent forums, and relevant syncs to stay current on business context and bring insights back into ESC operations.

* Coordinate with partners to ensure end-to-end case completeness and smooth employee and manager experience across teams.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $86,200.00 - $137,800.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $81,900.00 - $130,900.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

**Who you are**
---------------

* Comfortable in the gray space - you enjoy working through situations with multiple stakeholders and turning ambiguous requests into clear next steps.
* Energized by coaching managers in a way that balances employee experience, fairness and risk.
* Organized and focused on execution. You juggle many requests and close the loop with clean documentation.
* Systems, data, and AI-savvy. You’re excited to use AI tools to work faster, spot patterns and find better ways to support managers and employees.
* A trusted collaborator across teammates who is comfortable working both through tickets and through real-time collaboration (instant messages and live calls).
* Enjoy creating or iterating on SOPs, playbooks, and triage rules based on case pattern analysis and partner feedback.
Highly discrete and reliable when working with sensitive or confidential information related to performance, employee relations, or organizational changes.  

  

Qualifications

* 2+ years HR experience in shared services, employee service centers, employee relations, HR operations, or HR generalist roles
* Experience conducting employee or manager inquires and documenting them clearly and objectively
* Sound judgment in triaging, routing and escalating work based on complexity, risk and business context
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear guidance
Proficiency with Workday (or similar HRIS) and ServiceNow (or similar tools)  

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in an HR shared services / tiered support model or similar model where routing, SLAs, and escalation accuracy are core to success.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini) to improve workflows, documentation or analysis
